talk_text: #NAME#, if you're going to train someone to become the ultimate Overlord, you'll have to endure some tough challenges along the way.

You shouldn't take these trials lightly. 
They're crucial to achieving your ultimate goal.

Wait... Miss Etna... 
You've been concocting some awful scheme?

Ding dong♪! You guessed it, Flonne!
The Final Boss fight is about to begin!
Miss Etna, is this really the Final Boss battle? To be honest, I expected something a bit more impressive...

Keep watching! The show is about to begin.
Look over there.
We have finally found you, loathsome Overlord!!
When the darkness of evil is on the rise,
We crash the villainous party!
Our seven lights spring to the task,
To save the world with courage and hope!
With our powers combined we are--
The Prism...!!
Rangers!!!!

Oh, oh, oh!! This is so cool!!
It's the Prism Rangers!!
...What? Are you telling me that these guys are #NAME#'s Final Boss battle...???
Yes! They are the reason that we want to train someone to be the ultimate Overlord in the first place!

Awesome!
Come on, Prism Rangers, you can do it!

Wait a second, Flonne.
Why are you rooting for the Prism Rangers?

*Sniffles*
The Prism Rangers have lost.

Hmph... It doesn't matter which world you're talking about! 
Justice is never inevitable!
#NAME#, if you want to train someone to be the ultimate Overlord, you’re going to have to start doing whatever it takes to win.
The more despicable you are, the better! Betray, cheat! Indulge your every villainous whim!

Whenever someone doesn't do what you want, just bribe them or use violence to make them listen!
This is what a real demon would do!
Don't forget that #NAME# is actually a human...
Hahahaha...You think that defeating a couple of lame heroes like these guys counts as defeating the Final Boss? What a joke!!!
Oh my, he's here!
Hahahaha...You think that defeating a couple of lame heroes like these guys counts as defeating the Final Boss? What a joke!!!
Oh my, he's here!
Ah, Prince. How did you get here?
I heard that some upstart human was trying to train someone to become the ultimate Overlord.

...Hmm, and this is #NAME#?
You're quite bold for a human...
Forget it. I, the great Overlord Laharl, can tell whether you're right for the job. Let's see whether you're truly up to the task of training someone to be the ultimate Overlord!
You talk tough, but you were defeated so easily just now.
Prince Laharl is so weak.

Y-You idiots!
I was just testing this guy.

For the next battle, your opponents will be my very own elite troops!
Prepare yourself.

Oh wow.
It looks like Prince Laharl lost again.

T-This is impossible...!!
Why are my elite troops so pathetically weak...!!!??

Everyone knows that the Prince is an arrogant, selfish jerk!
You are not good enough to train other demons.

Prince, I'm curious...
How exactly did you train up those soldiers?
I've developed my own grueling training program...I make my soldiers play video games for 1000 hours straight, and forbid them from stopping to eat or drink, wash their hands or brush their teeth...
After they blow their nose, they have to show it to someone else. They're also forbidden from doing any homework during summer break. Basically, they have to get up to all sorts of bad behavior.
But... how does any of that help someone become stronger?
Quiet! Only I get to decide if someone is qualified to train the strongest Overlord! Let's go!

Humph!
It seems... 
that maybe I underestimated you #NAME#.

Let me show you how powerful I am 
when I'm at Lv9999!

All I have to do is eat this, and
I'll be able to transform into a Lv9999 Demon God "in the blink of an eye"!!
...How's that for an advertising slogan? It really helps sell the product, don't you think? Anyway, here goes...
Trans...form!
...What?

W-W-What 
is this...
...!!??
Ahhhhhh...!!!!!
I've been changed into a woman?! But I'm the great and fearsome Laharl!

Is this some kind of joke!?
How can I show off my true power when I look like this!?
Well...I dare say there are many people who would say this new look is a real improvement for you.
I don't know what you've got to complain about, with such a perfect feminine body...
Looks like there's going to be some tough competition in the beauty stakes around here from now on!

What?! Prince Laharl, do you really 
think you're a match for us two?

You idiots!!
Stop fooling around! 
Find a way to get me back to normal!!

Geez...alright Betty Boop.
Let's get outta here, #NAME#.

Miss Etna.
Do you know how we can get Laharl back to normal?
I have no idea.
...Well, that isn't very helpful.

Hey, it's time for dessert!!
Sometimes, a good sugar boost is all one needs to come up with a solution to any problem!

Are you sure it's not just that you're 
having sugar cravings, Miss Etna?
What's with this pudding!? Boom! It doesn't have that delicious springiness that pudding is supposed to have! I want to speak with the boss of this restaurant!

It's you! 
The legendary Mr. Champloo...!!

That's me!
I am also a Kitchen Fist Master, trained in the Fire Chaos Style!
Champloo - at your service! Boom!

Hey, Miss Etna...
Do you know this guy?

He's a legendary Netherworld chef.
He's a true culinary genius, he can transform literally any ingredients into a wonderful meal.
What in the world is going on...

My name is Etna!
I wish to challenge you to a cooking battle, to see who can make the best dessert!!
A challenge, you say!? Boom - I accept! ... What ingredients can we use?
Oh. As luck would have it, there are some Prinnies over there...

Hmm? How strange.
I used a ton of Prinnies in this recipe, so how come the dessert still isn't ready?
But surely it's not possible to make a dessert this way!

Blasphemy! Anything can be cooked if you set your mind to it! Boom!
Cooking comes from the heart!
Cooking is a life and death business, kid! Don't underestimate it!

Behold my latest recipe!
I call it...
"Puffy Prinny Pudding"! Boom!

Wow! I'm going to have to taste this right away!!
... Let's eat!

Ahh...that scent is incredible.
The texture is as smooth as silk. 
And its sweetness is unparalleled...

This...This is amazing!
It's an unprecedented creation! It's spectacular! It's the greatest dessert ever made!
...It looks like Miss Etna's completely forgotten about the Laharl situation.
To be continued...

Ooooh...So full...
I can't even move.

Me too...
When I'm full, I usually fall asleep and start snoring...

Hey, #NAME#.
These two are hopeless.
I guess I'm just going to have to rely on you for now.
There is only one way that this cursed body will be restored to normal!
...The Dark Assembly!!
The place known as the Dark Assembly is one of the Netherworld's many awesome features. You can go there and get your wishes granted.
But be careful. The Dark Assembly is a place of cutthroat competition between powerful demons of different political persuasions.
It isn't as simple as a genie in a lamp granting you three wishes.

Alright, #NAME#. Let's head to the Dark Assembly and bribe the Senators.
It's best to bribe the highest ranking Senator possible.
Girl Laharl has temporarily become your partner!
Girl Laharl will now fight alongside you as a Companion.

Listen up, #NAME#!
As their name suggests, demons are the embodiment and source of all things evil.
A good demon should never wash their hands after using the toilet. They should steal their crush's clarinet and lick it, draw unflattering sketches of their teachers during class...

They also play video games for 100 hours every day and never ever share their snacks... 
Tell me, are you scared?
So, I hear you ask, what kind of bribe could possibly tempt a demon...?
The trick is to be sly about it.

...I hope no one sees me.
If I am discovered, it would be a huge scandal.
I, Lord Axel, aka the most popular dark hero, need to be respected by the Netherworld. If I get caught, my little hobby may get found out, and that would be a real scandal.
...Finally, the end is in sight!
I've finally got my hands on a fantastic machine that can get rid of those stupid pixelations! I'm now finally free to spread my wings and soar!

Oh sure! Men all over the world dream about being able to remove those pesky pixels! 
The Senators are no different.

Did you two hear what I just said?! 
Aargh, no! I've been dreaming of this for years! Now, all hope is lost!

Hatred courses through my veins! 
I'll get you for this!
At this point, Axel begins crying tears of fury...
Axel then declares that he will one day take his revenge on #NAME#.
Hmph. In the Netherworld, the strong eat the weak. If you want to hate someone, you should hate yourself for being so weak.
(※ Note: This is a crime in the human world!)

Alright, #NAME#. Haha! Now, we're ready to bribe some Senators!
To the Dark Assembly!

I am Laharl, the Overlord!
Now Senators, listen to me. I've got something very important I'd like to discuss. Listen closely...
Give me back my real body!!
NAY! NAY! NAY! NAY!

Unbelievable!!
Well...I guess there is always another way to get people's approval.
#NAME#, come help me out!!
NAY! NAY! NAY! NAY!
Why!? Why are you all opposed!?

Overlord Laharl.
As the Speaker of the House, let me answer your question. All of us here are in agreement...
We all quite like your new appearance and we'd prefer that you stay this way.
...Huh?
Well...It's just that...we really like your new look.
S-Shut up! This is ridiculous!
Hahahahaha, don't pretend you can't see the signs!? You and I would make such a perfect match!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh
ahhhhhh!!!!!!!!!

What?!
This body is preventing me from using my full power...!!

Muahahahahaha!
Give it up!
You have no way of escape!!
Sexy...Beam!!
Sexy Beam's special effect..
Gwaaaaaaa!!?
The beautiful demon Etna has arrived!!

Get ready!
Love Punch!!

Love Punch's effect 
(Flonne's voice can also be heard shouting "Crab miso!")
Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!
The Angel of Love, Flonne, descends from the sky! Ta-daaa!!
Y-you guys are here...!

...Hmph. 
Late as always, I see.

Still as stubborn as ever. It's obvious you're happy to see us.
You never show a hint of honesty.
Yes well, that's just the Prince we know and love.

Well, then. 
Let's deal with these losers!
Prince Laharl and #NAME# will deal with the Speaker!

...Can't wait! #NAME#! 
Let's make bacon out of them!!
YEA! YEA! YEA! YEA!

A-Awesome!
We did it, #NAME#!!
The vote passed!
All it took was a little violence.
Well... This is the Netherworld, after all. So, who cares!

Oh? Oh?
My body...!!

Yes!!! I'm back!
No more melons!

Yes! This is the body of a real Overlord!!
Hahahahahaha!

...#NAME#.
I know an Overlord shouldn't say thanks, but...
To show my gratitude, I would just like to say, I believe you've got what it takes to train the greatest Overlord.
From this day forward, you will be my vassal.

#NAME# was made Laharl's vassal... without consent!
... And with no right to refuse...

In the future, we will fight side-by-side against even stronger enemies.
So, we've gotta start preparing.
Wow. Remember, the Prince doesn't hand out compliments very often, #NAME#.
So yeah, you should be proud of yourself for getting the Prince's approval so quickly.
#NAME# has such a pure and honest soul

...An admissions application?
From a human. How interesting.
Perhaps I can turn this human into a Delinquent.
To be continued...
Congrats, #NAME#! Welcome to the Evil Academy!
Flonne, this is all a bit unexpected.

Well, it isn't too late yet, and time is money.
If we're going to train someone to be the ultimate Overlord, we're going to have to help #NAME# speed things up a bit.

Ah...
So you're the transfer student I've been hearing about.

I am Raspberyl.
I am a Delinquent Teacher at this academy.

I've been hearing quite a bit about you, #NAME#.
I heard that you are a Delinquent.
However, as your homeroom teacher, I won't allow you to just be a common villain.
My goal is to make you the worst of the worst!!

Oh no!
What should we do about this, Miss Etna!?
I don't want #NAME# to become a Delinquent!

You don't think it would be wonderful?
I think it would be fascinating.
I will be very strict with you. I'll keep your nose to the grindstone right from day one. Which reminds me, our first lesson is on...
"Friendship"!!
Huh? Friendship?

Exactly! Learning about "friendship" 
is the first step towards becoming a true Delinquent!
Hmm... Why do I have the feeling that something bad is about to happen...?

Speak with your fists! That's how a real friendship is made!
Then you'll be able to do a triathlon as you run off into the sunset!
Come on! Class is in session, #NAME#!!

Excuse me, Ms. Raspberyl.
This class is all about "friendship", right?
Correct. If you want to be a Delinquent, you need to understand friendship.
...I have no idea what anyone's talking about.
Let me explain the values we believe in here at the Evil Academy!
What you call "good" in the Human World is villainous here, and students that you call "bad" are the Honor Students in the Netherworld.
At the Evil Academy, the rules of morality are flipped.
I see. This place truly is a Netherworld academy - utterly demonic through and through. Everything's all topsy-turvy.

Hmm... So, is enrollment open?
I am confident that I could also become an Honor Student.
It seems that you already know a thing or two about being evil, #NAME#.
I'm sure that you will be able to make some solid friendships sooner or later.

Stop! 
Stop teaching this class this instant...!!!

I got word that some popsicle was teaching 
all kinds of airy-fairy nonsense at MY academy... I should have guessed it was you, Raspberyl...

Hello, Mao.
Do you have something you'd like to contribute?
Do I..?!! What is the first rule of the Evil Academy...!? "Demons must have no friends!"

Anyone who becomes a student here 
is forbidden from forming friendships!!
Oh, #NAME#. Since you clearly have no respect for this rule, you are not worthy of being a student here!
I hereby expel you from the Evil Academy!!

You got guts. 
I accept this duel! And #NAME# shall fight on my behalf!

If you get kicked out on the first day of school, you'll instantly become the very top Honor Student. 
Come on #NAME#, fight!

If you lose, then I'll conduct my experiments on you!
Muahahaha!
Muahahahah...

Ok, prepare yourself!
Let's see how you handle my Doppelganger!

Nice work, #NAME#.
It may be just a clone, but it's not easy to beat Mao.

#NAME#. Ok, class is over for today.
...Let's battle one more time!!

Ms. Raspberyl!
It may be too late to say this, but I would just like to say, violence is bad.
Yea... It's too late.

Huh? What's violent about what we're doing?
This course is all about what it means when hearts and fists come together!!
Okay, now I understand!!
Flonne, you're so gullible.

Well done, #NAME#.
Your skills are quite impressive. 
They're getting me all fired up.
From now on, me and you will be like frenemies.
Yoroshiku, let's take care of each other, #NAME#.

A friendship that comes from the heart and from the collision of fists... 
That's the true meaning of youth!!
Flonne, will you also come to study at the Evil Academy? I think you'll have no problem becoming a Delinquent.

Hey, Raspberyl...
Don't you dare treat this human as your arch-rival (best friend)...

#NAME#.
I won't forget this.

Just you wait!
I'll conduct experiments on you yet!!
To be continued...

Is everyone here?
No tardies and no absences. Good, good.
You have all just started on your long journey to becoming a true Delinquent.

All rise!
Prepare yourselves!
Bow! Sit back down!

Heeheehee.
I've always wanted to do that.

Flonne, it seems you're settling into school life very well.
So, what are we learning about today?

Hmph...
Today's subject is "Volunteer Work"!

[Volunteer Work]
In ancient times, demons often used the phrase "expressing motherly love" to refer to volunteer work. Many demons feared doing it.
The etymology of this phrase can be traced back to the 13th Overlord of the Mourning Netherworld, Kuli.

At that time, the Mourning Netherworld was in financial difficulties, so it forced all its citizens to do unpaid labor. 
This was called the "Motherly Love Policy". That name has been used ever since.
The Overlord at that time wanted people to devote themselves to their country in the same way that mothers devote themselves to their children.

This policy was a complete failure. 
Eventually, it led to the Overlord being 
overthrown by his vassals.
That was an excerpt from the popular historical volume "How Volunteering Destroys Society".

Volunteer to help out your neighbors, just like a mother works tirelessly to look after her children!
What an awesome story.
It really helps people understand the importance of maternal love.

Hey, Flonne.
What's the matter with you?
Even if I did agree to do some volunteering, what exactly could we do?

We must protect the Evil Academy's morals! #NAME#!
The Nether Patrol has been dispatched!
The Nether Patrol... What an awesome name! I can see it now... we'll be riding in spaceships and driving transforming robots...
Haha! Just imagining it makes my heart start to beat fast and my nose bleed!
Ok Flonne, I think you need to take some deep breaths.

The Nether Patrol has one simple mission.
Any time they come across an Honor Student, they hit them in the face with a punch of pure love. That's it.

...Huh?
What about spaceships and transforming robots?

Ok! We're all set. Let's go volunteer 
and toil away our youth!!
I will not allow anyone to break the rules of this academy!!

What is the second rule of the Evil Academy...!?
"Never accept or give help to anyone else!"

But you want to do voluntary work!?
This is simply ridiculous!!
Prinnies, get out here!
Yes, master.
A couple of Prinnies. So what?
#NAME# has shattered our dream of improving our working conditions, dood...

But, there's more than one way to skin a Prinny!
His Majesty Mao has promised us that he will improve our working conditions!

*Sigh*
Out of interest, what exactly is Mao offering you?
To work all year round with no break! For 22 hours a day! For a daily salary of...2 sardines!! 2 whole sardines, dood!! That's a twofold increase for us, dood!

*Without enthusiasm* Oh wow.
As much as that...

And we will continue to improve our working conditions!
We will struggle until we are finally respected!! Let's fight, dood!!

Amazing! You've defeated those Prinnies who I lured into battling you with extra sardines.
You are worthy of being my test subject.

However, this next foe will be much more of a challenge...
Get out here! Pringer V3!!

An invincible robot created by modifying and combining Prinnies?!
Oh dear, that's terrible...
You say that, but I can see that steely glint in your eye, Flonne.

Hahaha!
The V in Pringer V3 stands for victory, dood!
No one can survive a face off with the Pringer V3, dood!

We will not forget the 3 Prinnies 
who sacrificed themselves during the struggle, dood!!
Victory will be ours, dood!!

Aaaaaah!!!
Pringer V3 was defeated...
If we want to defeat #NAME#, it seems we must resort to our ultimate weapon, the legendary Prinny Bomb, dood...

Ugghhh!!!!
The Pringer V3 was an ingenious creation of my own outstanding design. How could it be defeated...?!
Well, think about it... At the end of the day, it was still just 3 Prinnies put together.

*Sobbing*...
You should have given Pringer V3 to 
me instead of letting it get 
destroyed.*Sobs louder*.

No need to get all teary-eyed just yet!
Look over there.
Pringer V3 is getting up!

And it seems to be trying to express
 something. Is that look in its eyes...warmth? Friendliness?

#NAME#!
Let Pringer V3 join the party!!
Please, please, please, please, please, please! *this continues for about a minute*

#NAME#
has extended a hand of friendship to Pringer V3.
Pringer V3 has joined your team!

Yesterday's enemy is today's rival (friend).
You have cultivated a fiery friendship with an enemy...
Well done, #NAME#!

You're going to become an 
outstanding Delinquent. You really are full of surprises.

Ms. Raspberyl just said all that...
That means #NAME# is an 
incredibly good person, right?
Pretty much, yeah. But whether or not that's a good thing, I really can't say.

Miss Etna won't admit it, but she's expecting great things from 
#NAME#. 
Perhaps we really will be able to train the ultimate Overlord after all.
I'm not...

AHHHH...!!
I won't forgive you for this, #NAME#!
Enjoy your victory while it lasts.

Next time, I'll take you down once and for all.
I'll make you one of my test subjects yet!
To be continued...

Ms. Raspberyl!
What are you going to teach us today?

It looks like your genuinely excited to attend class. 
You have the makings of a true Delinquent, Miss Flonne!

Today, we will learn about...
"Doing Chores"!!

[Doing Chores]
Doing chores includes various household tasks like cleaning floors, washing clothes, and cooking. 
All the demons at the bottom of the social ladder used to do these things.

But then, Netherworld scientists
realized that doing chores 
can actually be therapeutic. They purify the soul, and can make you a better person.

This terrifying discovery sent shockwaves throughout the Netherworld. 
Lower class demons rebelled, refusing to do any more chores. 
The history books call this rebellion "The Bitter Squabble".

It is because of this rebellion 
that the Prinnies became our servants. Few demons today know this.

That was an excerpt from 
"A Secret History of Cleaning".

So, doing chores can help demons 
purify their hearts.

So, students, do you think 
a Delinquent would hold an umbrella over a stray dog on a rainy day?
Once you've done some cleaning, you'll understand why the answer is obviously "yes".

Ms. Raspberyl!
...I don't think that's correct.
This "cleaning", is just going to eventually end in a fight, isn't it...

Yes, but that's because this academy 
is just crawling with Honor Students.

Those good-for-nothings prefer to just
throw their garbage into the street rather than take the time to take care of it properly.

Hmph...
Well we can "clean" up these Honor Students at the same time as we clean up the garbage on the streets!

No.
We must use the lash of love 
to turn those hateful Honor Students towards the light of righteousness!

You idiot!
Students at this academy are supposed to be evil!
That is why it is called the EVIL Academy!

What is the third rule of the Evil Academy...!?
"A demon should be curious and always look for new ways to be evil!"

A demon should live without a conscience! 
If a demon wants to do something, they shouldn't let morality stop them!

If you REALLY must do some cleaning, why don't you go to the [Item World]
and get me an "Elixir"!!

Eh?
Why do you want an Elixir?
Because I need it for an experiment!!
Everything's always all about YOU, isn't it!?

C-Come on! Go get me an Elixir!
If you don't get it, don't even think about ever getting a good grade in this academy!

You triggered a special task:
[Go to the Item World to get an Elixir]

If you don't complete this task, you can't progress further in this game!
So you need to complete it.

Not bad, #NAME#. 
You successfully obtained the Elixir!

You need to give it to 
His Majesty Mao as soon as possible.

Hey, did you forget our conversation?
Here's the Elixir you asked for.

Oh!
I didn't think you'd get it so quickly!
Damn you #NAME#, maybe you really do have potential...

Is that all?
If that's everything, then I will go back to my class now.

Alright...
But don't think for a second we're done with this topic.
Stop right there, #NAME#!

Mao...
What's your problem?
Why are you always causing trouble?

Hehehehe...
No trouble. I'd just like to give you a 
little something as thanks for all the 
cleaning you've done.

Da-da-da-dun!
The Dark Hero, Axel!
Like a phoenix, I have been reborn!!

I saw this guy fall into a garbage dump. 
So I took him home and transformed his body.
With that Elixir.

Well, isn't that exactly what recycling is all about?
I never knew you were such a Villain at heart, Mao!

Y-You idiot! This is just an experiment... An EVIL experiment!
I've created a stimulant!
And look at the results!

Power...
The incredible power!!
I feel like my heart is about to burst out of my chest!!
Uh...I think you may be having a myocardial infarction...

Listen carefully, can you hear it? 
That's the sound of the crowd from my most legendary performance ever.
Shouting for an encore!!
Erm...I think you are imagining things.

【警告】
ドーピングとは

...is the use of drugs 
to improve athletic ability. 
Athletes try to conceal the fact that they do this.

This behavior is forbidden in sporting events like the Olympics in the Human World 
because it violates the spirit of athletics
and the principles of fair competition.

Additionally, drugs can often cause
serious side effects for humans. 
Good children must never do drugs.

Finally, I will have my revenge!
I don't want to be a human, #NAME#!!

What...? 
You were never a human in the first place.
Are you going crazy? It looks like that stimulant has scrambled your brain.

No, no, that is not what I mean. 
I just mean I'm ready to risk everything 
to get my revenge. You should learn to listen more carefully.

...One more time.
I don't want to be a human, #NAME#!!

Wow...! Just this once
I choose to let you live...

But #NAME#!
If you think that you can become more powerful than me, you're deluding yourself!
If you really want to be better than me, you'll have to learn how to rock out better than me...
Honestly! We managed to overcome all these obstacles, but our day of cleaning has been completely disrupted.

Sorry, everyone.
I guess my teaching style still needs some work...
No, don't talk like that, Ms. Raspberyl!

At the very least, we managed to clean up that piece of garbage Axel! 
That was exactly the same as
cleaning the slime off dinner plates!
Flonne, even when you say something super mean, you still say it with a smile on your face..

That's true! Mao himself said 
he found Axel in a garbage dump, right?
So you could say that we've successfully taken out the trash!

...Alright, let's continue our class!
Next, we should conduct one melee battle before the sun goes down!!
Yes, Ms. Raspberyl!

...So, #NAME#.
Do you think Axel is recyclable garbage?
Or is he destined straight for landfill?

Huh!?
... W-What is this place?

You're harder to kill than a cockroach.
Excellent.
You can definitely be made stronger.

Well, of course!
I am the strongest Dark Hero in 
the entire Netherworld!

Let me ask you a question, Axel.
You just said you don't want to be a human, right?

You seem very determined. I admire that...
Hahahahah...

Wait...
W-Why are you smiling like that!?

I will help you become stronger.
I'll attach a drill to your right hand and a rocket launcher to your left. 
On your right foot, I'll attach a Gatling gun and...

What!?
No! Don't come any closer!
N-N-Nooo!!!
To be continued...

So, this class is finally coming to its end.
Are you ready, #NAME#?

Of course! Don't pull your punches!
Ok? #NAME#.

A good answer!
Today, we will learn about...
"Fundraising"!!

[Fundraising] 
There is a famous proverb in the Netherworld about fundraising. 
It goes: "sell your parents to honor them."

A long time ago, there was a demon who was the perfect son to his parents.
He wanted to build his parents a magnificent tomb to honor them after their deaths, so he traveled everywhere to raise funds to build it.

He did everything he could think of to earn money.
He hung around near vending machines to pick up any loose change. 
He even became a scrap collector.
After doing this for 1000 years, this demon finally became very rich.

His hard work really paid off.
He was able to build a magnificent tomb to honor his parents.

But what happened to his parents?
Well...The demon had been so determined to raise funds 
that he even sold his parents in a bid to raise more cash.

That was an excerpt from 
"Proverbs and Allegories of the Netherworld".

Charities exist in the Netherworld. 
But don't forget we are talking about demons here.
Do any demons actually donate to charity?

Of course not.
So, we need to find a way to persuade them.
Sometimes, the lash of love will need to be used.

Is that so...
Wouldn't that just be blackmail...?

(Note: 
Blackmail is a crime in the Human World!)

I guess that leaves Croix and Eclair then.

Right.
I'm pretty sure they're both fine.
I'm just worried they might get tricked like Alouette.
Very impressive, Croix.
No sweat. This is nothing.

That's the spirit.
Keep on displaying your amazing skills!
Sure thing. I've got this.
That voice...

It's Croix!
From somewhere over there!
Above you.
*screeching*

Wonderful!
I knew you could pull it off.
The number of spectators continues to grow and grow!
Looks like we'll be making more sales than expected!
Glad I could live up to your expectations.

[Croix] A freelance exorcist who has accompanied Prier and her friends ever since a certain incident.
He travels from place to place trying to regain his lost memories.
A cheerful and reliable individual.
What the heck are you doing, Croix?

Hm?
Well, if it isn't Prier and the others.
Looks like we finally found you.
I don't get the impression you were searching for us at all…
Croix, what is the meaning of all this?

Isn't it obvious?
I'm displaying my marksmanship for Seraphina's marksman show.
It's quite thrilling to see a marksman show with demons as the targets.

I'm sure Croix's marksmanship is a sight to behold, but we're saving the fun for the festival.
First we need to find Eclair.
...Sounds like you're determined to enjoy the festival, Prier.

Come on, Croix.
Let's hurry.
Sorry, no can do.
What? Why not?
Because Croix is going to stay here with me forever as my love slave!
What! Love slave?!
What'd you mean "love slave"?!
I'm not her slave, but when I was catapulted off to this world, Seraphina was the one who looked after me.
I collapsed from hunger while I was looking for all of you...
Seraphina's vassal—Prinnies or whatever they're called—carried me on their backs, and Seraphina ended up feeding me and putting a roof over my head.

Oh-Hohohohoho!
I took good care of Croix and showered him with love and attention!
L-Love and attention...
Then when I saw how talented Croix was as a marksman, I asked him to perform in my show.
I'm surprised Croix agreed to participate in such a spectacle.

Well, I still do owe her for food and board.
Besides, the pay's good.
Might not be a bad idea to stick around Seraphina for a little while longer.
Of course! It won't just be the show. I'll feed, clothe, and shelter you. Nothing will stop me from transforming you into my love slave!
H-Hold on! Feed, clothe, and shelter? Doesn't that mean you'll be living together? And what's all this about him being your love slave?
I won't allow it!

What's the matter?
Why are you so worked up?

You must've been seduced and brainwashed by that demon!
Fine, I'll knock some sense into you!
Repent, you perverted idiot!

Hey, cut it out!
I'm clear-headed!

Indeed you are!
There will always be obstacles that stand in the way of love!
We'll take them on together!
Quit changing the narrative!
Oh boy, that was a devastating defeat...

Now that I've won, there's no need for you to be in the show.
Come on, Croix.
Let's go.

All right, all right. Fine. 
Anyway, Seraphina did just say there were already more sales than she expected.

Sorry for the trouble, everyone.
I'll be joining you!

Turning a man from another world into your slave?
You really are a piece of work, Seraphina.
Does that mean you're over Killia?

Of course not.
And now my attempt to win Sir Killia's affection is ruined!
If only I'd managed to succeed in turning Croix into my slave, I'm certain it would've made Sir Killia jealous... Aaaghh!

So that's what this was all about.
Well, time to come up with a new strategy.
Good luck!
The only one missing now is Eclair.
Croix, you better do your part and make up for all the trouble you caused.
I know, I know.

That said, the Netherworld is vast.
Do you really think we'll find her that easily?
Well, we were all sucked into the Nether Gate at the same time, so I doubt she could've gone very far.

You're doing it all wrong!
You have to bat from your hips!
Come on!
Twist your hips more!
Th-The hips! Got it.
Sis, that's Eclair's voice!
Over there. Let's hurry!

Come on, Eclair!
Try it again!

Right, it's all in the hips. Here goes!
Now!
That swing was way different from the others, dood!!!

That one wasn't down the center!
Good job, Eclair!
Okay, next!
I'm going for the home run!
The pain is so addicting, dood!!!

No way, that's incredible!
You hit a home run!

Thank you so much!
It was only possible because you were so patient with me, Miss Fuka!

I can't believe I sent that adorable Prinny flying across the air...
Me, the Princess of the Kingdom of St. Paprika... Heheheh.

...I'm not sure what I just witnessed.
Was that the royal princess beating the heck out of a demon?

Y-Yeah.
I've never seen Eclair like that before.
She definitely appears to be enjoying herself.

This looks fun!
Let me have a swing!

Hm?
Oh, hey there, Ms. Beryl, #NAME#.

Would you all like to try a Straw Doll Festival classic?
I call it Fuka's One-Hit Wonder Home Run!

Using Prinnies as baseballs?
That's quite an idea you've come up with, Fuka.
You know how Prinnies explode when you throw them?
Well, we compete to see who can make them fly the furthest before they explode!

Th-That sounds terribly cruel...
I wonder if the Goddess would forgive such behavior.

It'll be fine!
Even if you go overboard, just transfer all the blame onto the straw doll before we burn it!
What a terrifying festival...

Bi-Big Sister?
Guys?

[Eclair]
Princess of the Kingdom of St. Paprika.
As a "Saint of Light" candidate, she is burdened by the high expectations of those around her.
Prier and Culotte have been her best friends for the past few years, and she affectionately refers to Prier as "Big Sister".
How long have you been watching?!

Let's see...
I guess around the "Twist your hips!" part.

That long?
I-I can't believe I behaved like that in front of you, Big Sister...
I'm so ashamed of myself!
You've got nothing to be ashamed about.

You've got talent, Eclair!
Those were some clean swings!
N-No, it's not like that!
I got a little carried away, but I really didn't want to send those Prinnies flying!
What? But I've never seen you so excited before, Eclair. Come on, admit it. You had fun beating up those Prinnies, didn't you?

Lemme have a go as well.
Let's send those Prinnies flying together!
Waahhh?!

Please!
Forget about what you just saw!

I can't.
It was so intense.

O-Oh no...
How am I supposed to live with myself!
Listen, Eclair, if you really want to, you can use this.

This is the bat I just used!
What am I supposed to do with this?!
Use it to blow away your memories, just like you blew away the Prinnies!

I-I see...
Yes, this may be my only option—

Calm down, Eclair!
What're you panicking about?
Well? Have you calmed down a little?

Yes...
I was distressed, but I should never have lashed out like that.
I'm sorry...

You've got nothing to apologize about.
We're all still alive and breathing!
Eclair, why were you playing with Fuka's exhibit?
Ever since we ended up in this world, I've been looking for all of you, but...
For some reason, the demons around here seem different than the ones we're usually up against.
As Princess of the Kingdom of St. Paprika, I've been conflicted about whether or not I should exorcise them.

Jeez, Eclair.
You're too much of a straight arrow.
Just because someone's a demon, doesn't mean you have to exorcise them.
...Well, Sis, you did try to kill one as soon as we got here.
I just happened to pass by Eclair when she seemed all confused, so I invited her to join me.
There's nothing like batting away your worries, you know!

I see.
So that's how it all happened.
I feel bad for what I did to the Prinnies, but swinging that bat just felt so good, I couldn't stop myself...
As Princess of the Kingdom of St. Paprika, I feel ashamed of myself...

What's there to be ashamed about?
Nothing wrong with a princess letting off steam during a festival.
If you're really worried, then transfer all your sins onto the last straw doll we burn today!
Fu-Fuka...

Don't hold it in, Eclair.
We'll accept you no matter what.

I mean, look at Prier.
She's always running around out of control and getting scolded by Alouette.

Yeah, exac...
Hold on!
Don't drag me into this!

Big Sister, Culotte...
Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

Glad to see you feel better.
If you feel like blasting away Prinnies again, come by any time!
Thank you! I promise I'll be back!
Gi-Give me a break, dood...
Well then, Prier, does this mean you've gathered all your friends?

Yes.
Thanks a lot, Beryl and #NAME#!
Now all that's left is to fix the gate so that it connects back to our world.
Isn't Beryl's friend looking into that?
Before that, there's one more thing we have to do.
What do you mean?
We need to find the giant straw doll that's vital to this festival!
I'm surprised you remember, Prier.

Of course!
We promised to help you.

Prier is right, Ms. Beryl.
We wouldn't have gotten this far without you and the others.
We want to do our part to help you find what you're searching for.

Thank you, everyone!
But I don't even know where to start our search.
I never even heard about a giant straw doll before coming here.

Who cares about the straw doll!
We still don't have enough data.

I need all of you to stir up more chaos!
Or else what's the point of even summoning you!
What're you doing here, Mao?
What do you mean by "you need us to stir up more chaos"?

Sis, did you hear what Mao said?
Sounded like he was suggesting he was the one who summoned us here...
Mao, what in the Netherworld have you done?

Heh!
It was I who summoned Prier and her friends here.
I required new subjects to complete my research!
It all makes sense now.

But why?
You're friends with Beryl and #NAME#, aren't you?
That's got nothing to do with this.
Why did you do it, Mao?
You might not know this, Beryl, but lately there's been an increasing number of otherworldly visitors here in the Netherworld.
So we weren't the first then.

Sure, I know.
And what about it?
Don't you realize just how valuable otherworldly test subjects are?!
As much as I wanted to study and dissect the previous visitors, they returned to their own world before I could learn everything about them.
They had their excuses, contract periods, grown-up matters and the likes! In any case, my appetite for research remained unsatisfied!
That's why I used my Dimension Gate and the giant straw doll to connect Prier's world with ours!
I understand now why you brought us to this world, Mao, but how did you manage to pull it off?
I wasn't certain if modifying the Dimension Gate alone would be enough.
However, when Beryl brought up the festival, it reminded me of the straw doll. You see, by modifying the Dimension Gate as well as the straw doll...

It fuses science and the occult together.
That's the solution I came up with!
I injected the straw doll with my magic before burning it. By placing its ashes into the Dimension Gate, the gate was activated.
As a result, Prier and her friends were summoned to our world!

So you're the culprit!
And I can't believe you burned our precious giant straw doll ahead of time!
Wow, so that's all it takes to connect our two worlds?

I can't miss out on this opportunity.
You're all wonderful test subjects.
And rest assured you will assist me in my research!

*huff* *huff* Don't worry.
I won't hurt you.
I just need to extract a bit of data.
*slurp*
So, not only are you going to experiment on us, but you want to dissect us as well?!

Damn it...
This has gone too far.
Time to get serious.
Mao's hunger for research seems to be causing him to spiral out of control.
We must engrain the teachings of the scriptures into his being and set him on the right path.

Why don't we just crush him first?
I'll put the fear of the Goddess into him with my fist!
Sounds like Mao's up to his usual tricks. But this time, as a delinquent and a board member of the festival committee, he'll have to pay for what he's done!
Let's go!

Why?!
I planned on sending you back once my experiments were complete!
Somehow, I doubt we would've returned home in our original state...

She's right, Mao.
You tried to force Prier and the others to be a part of your selfish plan.
Let them return to their own world.
You don't deserve it, but we'll forgive you if you send us back.
I can't.
Excuse me?
I said I can't.

Why not?
You summoned us here!
You should be able to send us back!

Of course I can.
Who do you think I am?
I just mean that I can't right now.
Why not?
Because the straw doll is gone.
I fused the straw doll's ashes with my magic and used it as a catalyst to connect our two worlds.
In that case, why don't we just prepare a new straw doll?

It's not that simple.
That giant straw doll was composed of highly unique materials.
Gathering all of the materials from scratch will take some time.

Tsk.
So does that mean we're stuck here for a while?

Oh no!
What do we do, Sis?

Don't ask me!
Oh boy...
After all that, I'm starting to get hungry.

In that case, why don't we have a look around the festival?
I can be your guide.

Great idea!
I can't stop thinking about that grilled pork stall we saw earlier!

I'm coming too!
I've always wanted to visit a festival with you, Big Sister!

I-In that case...
A-Alouette!
W-W-W-Would you like to see the fe-festival with... me?

Hehe.
Guess it doesn't hurt to let loose a bit every once in a while.

I've never been to a festival before.
Could you escort me, Culotte?
Gladly!

Jeez, you people have boundless energy.
I'll be napping until the gate is ready.

Quit trying to play cool.
You're coming with us!
You should be buying me a drink for all the trouble you caused!

Hold on!
If you have time to play around, you should be assisting me in my research!
The only thing you should be worrying about is making that straw doll!

We're here.
This is where the massive magic signal was coming from.

Impressive.
Must be quite the opponent considering how many Prinnies they managed to take out.
But there's no one here.

How about we lure them with sardines?
I doubt anyone could resist a batch of freshly caught sardines!
Much as I'd like to cook it up now, it seems we have other matters to deal with.

So, it's you people.
You're the ones rumored to wield immense power in this world.
Don't tell me she's the one who did all this.

Hey, you!
Who the hell do you think you are rampaging around without my permission!

My name is Priere.
Overlord Priere.

[Overlord Priere] A powerful Overlord who is the spitting image of Prier.
She can be differentiated by the fact she shows more skin than Prier.
They both share similar personalities, but Overlord Priere hides an immense dark power.

Priere?
Hey Mao, wasn't Prier that human who was with you and the others?

Heheheh...
She may look the same, but this individual posses magic powers worthy of an Overlord.

Hmm...
Guess there's some truth to the rumors.

Far from being afraid of me, you chatter on without a care in the world.
How interesting.

I came here because that Nether Gate was emitting powerful dark magnetic waves.
Looks like my hunch was correct.

A gate?
But it shouldn't be connected to Prier's world yet.

Unless...
Perhaps the remaining effects of the straw doll have connected it to another gate.

Quit yapping on. What I want is to fight people that are strong.
That way, I can become even stronger.

Which one of you is the strongest?
I'll fight you first.

I'm the strongest, of course.
I'm the most badass freakin' Overlord in the entire cosmos!

That's not necessarily true.
No one can match my brains.
I may not be an Overlord, but I train every day!
Thanks to power of sardines, I feel capable of beating anyone!
Jeez, you sound like children with all your bragging.
You. Why haven't you said anything all this time? Are you that confident in your abilities?

Me?
Not necessarily—

I like your confidence!
Fine!
I'll start by kicking your butt!

Hey!
No way you chose Killia over me!

Jeez, what's with all the commotion?
Wait, is that Prier?

Big Sister, why are you dressed like that?
You look just like a demon!

No way, Sis!
Have the effects of the Netherworld transformed you into an Overlord?

Wait, this feels familiar...
Haven't we experienced a similar phenomenon before?
It reminds me of what happened that time when Eclair couldn't contain her negative emotions.

Sister Alouette.
Are you saying that this is the personification of the darkness in Prier's soul?

We can talk about it later.
Right now we need to act.

Right.
We can't let this happen to her, even if being an Overlord somehow suits her better.

Agreed.
We've got to stop her!

Ahahahah!
Not bad at all.
I haven't been this excited in a while.

Glad to hear that.
Now it's my turn to have some fun.

Listen up, all of you!
I claim Prier as my test subject.
Capture her alive at all costs!

A former human turned Overlord...
Nothing could make for a more fascinating test subject.
*huff* *huff* *slurp*
Looks like Mao can't wait to dissect her.

Dissect Prier?
Absolutely not!
I won't allow it!

What should we do, Alouette?
He's going to kill her!
Leave it to me, Culotte.
I'll rely on the teachings of the scriptures to appeal to Prier's soul.

Lame!
I'll keep fighting instead!

But, Laharl, our casualties will only increase if we continue to fight.
Let me finish her off with one final blow.

Please, wait!
If she really is Prier, you can't kill her!

Don't worry.
It may be the darkness in her soul that's the cause of all this.

If so, I may be able to use my Ultimate Demon Technique to purify the darkness.
Leave it to me.

You're up to something, aren't you?
Interesting.
Come on then, I've still got... Huh?

Big Sister?
What's the matter?

Looks like I'm out of time.
Don't think I can fight anymore.

Oh well.
I got to fight a strong opponent, so I'm pretty sure I'm even stronger now.

Hold on, wait!
I still need to examine you up close...
Shame we couldn't settle this, but I've got things I need to do.

Next time I run into you, you're going down.
Remember that, as you quake in your boots, waiting for that day to come.
See you then!

Sis, wait!
Sis!

N-No...
Prier...
What will I do without you?

...Don't worry, Alouette.
I'll go find that idiot and bring her back.

Jeez, pipe down, will you?
People are trying to sleep over here.

B-Big Sister?
What're you doing over there?
You just vanished!

Yeah!
What've you been up to all this time?

What're you talking about?
Eating all that dinner made me sleepy, so I've been asleep until now.

You're quite the troublemaker, Prier.
In the name of the Saint of Light, you'll be hearing it from me later!

Can't believe I was even worried about you.
Now that I think about it, there's no way Prier would turn into a demon.
Thanks goodness... I'm so relieved.
Prier, sit still for a second.

Wh-What's the matter, Mao?
Do I have something on my face?

...Nothing.
I detect no trace of that Overlord-like power that was present in the other one.
Huh? What the heck is an Overlord?

Listen up, Prier!
I'm going to dissect you this minute and uncover your secrets.
*huff* *huff* *slurp*
絶対に嫌よ！

Damn it!
When will I get my hands on that ultimate test subject!

#NAME#, have you heard the news?
Prince Laharl is hosting the Netherworld's Strongest Tournament.

The fiercest fighters in all the Netherworld have gathered in the Coliseum to fight it out.
This battle will decide the best of the best.
Um, Prince Laharl is at odds with Adell and his friends, right?
Why did he have to gather all the fierce fighters in the Netherworld?
Probably 'cause he thought it'd also be a good opportunity to show he's the strongest.

But we won't let that happen.
Listen, #NAME#, the tile of "strongest" belongs to us.

#NAME#, the tournament is about to begin.
Are you prepared?

Don't sweat it.
I've got your back.
Now then, time to take out the prince and claim the title of Overlord.
#NAME#, I owe you for helping with Adell. Of course I'll assist you.

After all I've put you through, sure I'll help you out, #NAME#!
Think of it as my apology!

M-Me too!
You've saved me plenty of times as well.
You can rely on me!
...What's the matter?
Rozalin, #NAME#, I'm sorry, but I want to join another team.
Rozalin, #NAME#, I'm sorry, but I want to join another team.
ええ！？
Hold on, what the heck are you talking about?!
I-If you do that, you'll be separated from Rozalin.
What are you scheming?

...I'll cut to the chase.
Adell, I want to challenge you in the Coliseum.
Me? What for?
To earn the right to be Rozalin's father.

The right to be her father?
Are you actually serious?
Yeah, I'm serious.

...Very well.
I accept your challenge!

Hey!
What do you think you're doing, Fake Zenon!

I happen to be working undercover!
Now all my hard work is down the drain!
Miss Lucy, here on boss' orders, dood. He said he had a feeling you'd be in trouble.

Amazing!
Oh, he's good!
I happen to be right smack in the middle of trouble!

Call Diez and the others immediately!
Tell them I need backup!
Aye aye, dood!!
I can't believe it...
Fake Zenon actually challenged Adell to a showdown.
He really is trying to become Rozalin's father...

You've aaall been waiting for this moment!
It's time for the Netherworld's Strongest Tournament!

I am your host Dark Hero Axel!
Aaand...

Netherworld Idol 
Lanzarote here! ♪

A glamorous idol of the Netherworld.
She performs on tour all around the Netherworld, her popularity exceeding that of some Overlords.
She's an idol who sings, dances, and fights.
Currently serving under Overlord Laharl, she also has a personal relationship with Sicily who is a fan of hers.
We've got more than 100 Overlords and Majins participating in this Netherworld's Strongest Tournament!

Lemme introduce you to some of the strongest teams rumored to be in the running for the championship!
You ready for this, #NAME#?
The fusion of Netherworld and Human World science☆ Transforming mad brains into power☆ Watch us modify every participant♪

Mao and Genjuro Kazamatsuri the science duo!
What fate awaits N.E. Des X?!
It's Team New Z♪
*huff* *huff* *slurp* Time to reveal the results of our joint research!

That's right.
We're counting on you, Des X.

Leave it to me, Dad!
I'll slash the galaxy to shreds for you!

Up next!
Power is in the eye of the eater!
Four fillets and seven curries ago!
Make food not war!

IT's the duo leaders Valvatorez and Killia!
Make some noise for Team Sardine Curry!
...Love sardines.
...Curry rules.
If anyone defies my Lord, whether it be one of the Original Overlords, I'll turn them into a can of sardines.

Is that so?
Well if you ever betray Sir Killia, I'll hunt you down like a dog.

Um, guys?
We're on the same team, so let's try and work together.
Okay?

There are still championship candidates to come!
Stay tuned!

A mismatched group with no sense of loyalty...
I'll turn you all into rice balls♪

I heard you all love rice balls.
Is that true?
Can I call you Team Rice Ball?♪

Sorry for asking to join your team on such short notice.
You have my thanks.

Don't worry about it!
So long as we get to kill those damn Fallen Angels, I'll have achieved my goal!
*nom nom* So long as I get rice balls, I'll have achieved mine!
Next up we have gathered some of the strongest warriors from across time and space!
These powerful warriors we have selected will launch an attack on the fierce warriors of the modern era!

A love and summoning duo!
They'll be fighting as a family!
Go Team Salmon!

Heheheh!
Sorry I kept you waiting!
The strongest warrior is here!
We'll show them that Big Sis wins in both love and war, death!

Leave it to me!
I'll use my machinist skills to prove it for a fact!

A young girl who utilizes a special skill called Mechanology to summon Fuka and Desco and stop the war which took place in the human world.
She encountered Artina when she was still a nun and Valvatorez when he was still a tyrant.
Yeah! Let's do it!
Alrighty! We've got this!

Kids!
Don't get overexcited and end up dead!
Adell's mother-in-law living in Holt Village. Once a human, she was cursed by Zenon and became a demon. So, her past memories as a human are hazy.
And now, last but not least, it's the man of the hour!
He is your host of the Netherworld's Strongest Tournament, the self-proclaimed Overlord of Overlords!
Give it up for Prince Laharl of Team I Am No. 1!♪♪♪
Heheheh! Glad to see you've all gathered here today! Now then, are you ready to bow before me?

I am the strongest in all the Netherworld, and today I'm going to prove it!
Hah-hahaha!

Fighters, are you ready?!
The Netherworld's Strongest Tournament will be a no holds barred deathmatch!
If you value your life, then tuck your tail between your legs and run along home while you still can!☆
All right then! First we have the qualifiers for the main tournament! No half measures! Give it all you've got!
And so, with the fiercest fighters in all the Netherworld gathered together, the Netherworld's Strongest Tournament begins!
Will #NAME# be able to bring the conflict between the five protagonists to its conclusion?
When the darkness of evil is on the rise...
We crash the villainous party!
Our seven lights spring to the task...
To save the world with courage and hope!
With our powers combined we are...
The Prism...!!
The Prism Rangers!

Ooohhh!
The Prism Rangers are back!
Guess we're up against these guys for the first qualifiers.

Hold on.
Doesn't their team have way too many people?

You're right.
Hey, Prism Rangers.
Who are those individuals behind you?

Glad you asked.
These are our newfound friends!

From Evil Academy we have the Diez Gentlemen. From the Netherworld we have the Three Heroes of the Netherworld, the Four Devas of the Netherworld, the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld, and the Ten Kings of the Netherworld!
We call ourselves Team 41!
多すぎるわっ！！

They can't even call themselves Prism or Rangers anymore.
How sad...

All right, #NAME#!
Let's fight this out fair and square!
The Prism Rangers have been defeated.
We the Diez Gentlemen are your next opponents!

Glorified as a legend among legends, they are the backbone of the senior students of the Evil Academy. Despite the existence of female members, they call themselves gentlemen. Once affiliated with Super Hero Aurum, now they belong to the Evil Academy but take orders from no one.

Diez Gentleman?
They possess around the same strength as Salvatore's. And there's 10 of them...
Well, technically nine since Salvatore isn't here!

Sounds like fun!
I'm always up for a good fight!

You've got a good attitude!
You're a worthy opponent!
Since you asked for it, we the Diez Gentlemen will give you a taste of our might!
Now you're up against the Three Heroes of the Netherworld!

An elite force that is part of the Netherworld Government.
They are made up of three members: Thunder Emperor Psylos, Tromayer the Atrocious, and Baltis the Dreadful.
They symbolize fear in the human world.

Hold on!
We Four Devas of the Netherworld are next!
The rest is omitted.

chara3_name: Prinny,One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
You can't just jump in like that, dood!
Us Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld are—
The rest is omitted.

chara3_name: King Slumber Cat of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Nonsense!
It's time meow for the Ten Kings of the Netherworld!
The rest is omitted.

I've had enough of this.
#NAME#, let's just finish them all now.

They've been introduced like random filler characters.
How sad...
