Your Highness, I say we ditch this castle and snag some sweets from the fridge.

Is my castle not important to you?!
Take this fight more seriously!
But no matter how many times I attacked that Colossal Prinny there, it didn't seem to budge.
Hump. Just a bigger prinny, so you guts have grown with your size, huh?

Valvatorez, #NAME#! What's going on?!
I thought you were finding a solution for this!

Sorry to keep you waiting!
We've called on professional giant slayers from the Summoning Jar!

Your Highness!
What perfect timing!
Very good, then!
Up close like this, this thing's just as big as the Colossal Titan.

[Levi] He is the squad captain of the Scout Regiment in his own world.
He is widely known as humanity's strongest soldier, and is referred to as "Captain" by his comrades.

Our way of fighting might not be suited for this...
Eren, what do you think?

[Mikasa Ackerman] She has been by Eren's side ever since he saved her life when she was a child.
Protecting Eren means everything to her, and she wears the scarf he gave her at all times.

If exterminating this thing is the way back home, then I'll do what I have to!
Killing titans is the only thing I care about.

[Eren Jeager] A boy who yearns to explore the world beyond the wall.
After joining the Cadet Corps, he aims for a post in the Scout Regiment who is attempting to expand past the wall.
He is strong-willed and rushes headlong into danger.
These humans are our ace to defeat it?
No human can hurt me, dood!
Back off.
I take that back, dood!

I-it exploded when you tossed it!
Mikasa, how did you do that?!
I don't know. I was only trying to protect Eren.
Ah, don't worry about it. Prinnies explode when you throw them.
This world's got some real issues. Let's just hurry up and get this over with.

Oh wow! Their decision making is so fast. And I've never seen such weapons and equipment before!
I must examine it thoroughly!
They appear to be soldiers who fight giants in their own world.
Then stopping the Colossal Prinny should be easy for them.

All we have to do is exterminate that giant blue thing and we'll return to our own world, right?
In that case, I'll do it!

Just hold on.
We don't want it exterminated.
Just stop it so it can be re-educated!
Eren's right. The only way to stop their invasion is to defeat it.

...Hey, Valvatorez.
What's with that weird stitching on the bird's belly?

Inside Prinnies reside the souls of sinners.
That seam is what's holding them all inside.

So can't we just slice open the seam and let all its souls out?
Then you'll only be left with its skin.

True. But how would you go about that?
Our opponent is ginormous.
We'd never get close enough.
Maybe not you, but we can.

Compared to the nape of the titans in our world, this is much easier to aim for!
I'll show you how it's done, Valvatorez!
All right. I'll back you up. We'll put a stop to these Colossal Prinnies!
I can't hold it in anymore, dood!
The Colossal Prinny burst into normal-sized Prinnies?!

So it wasn't a giant?
Just a skin stuffed with other Prinnies?
I feel dizzy, dood...
And extremely hungry, dood...
Being stuffed into that giant skin must have consumed a great amount of energy out of them.

Oh, Prinnies!
I've got some sardines here!
Come and get it!

Sardines!
You're the best, Lord Valvatorez!
Much thanks, dood!

Yeah, eat up.
We'll have you re-educated when you've got your energy back.
As a Prinny Instructor, I won't stand by and watch giant Prinnies trample around the Netherworld!
I'll teach everyone how to prevent situations like this from occurring again!
It looks like our job here is done.
Eren, does this mean we can go home now?

That was the deal, right, Valvatorez?
So what should we do to get back?

Humans from another world, why the rush?
You just took down a Colossal Prinny!
You should be proud!

I've never seen such strength coming from mere humans. Please, let me research you and your equipment!
*drool*

There's no time for that!
If we don't get back soon, our friends could be in danger!
They need us to help fight against the titans!
Well said, Eren. Valvatorez, we kept our side of the promise. The Colossal Prinny is defeated.
So now it's your turn.
It appears it's already begun.
Eren, your body is glowing.
It's just like when we first came to this world.

Not this again!
At least leave me with one of your weapons!
Sorry, but we need them for exterminating titans.
I wish we could have talked more. Thank you for helping us!
You saved us the trouble of moving all the sweets from the fridge.
I think you need better priorities.
Eren, thank you for helping us stop the Colossal Prinny.

If you ever need help, please reach out to us.
We'll have your back.
Yeah, I'll be sure to keep that in mind. Everyone... stay strong out there.
In the end, how did the Prinnies get so big anyway?
It's over now, so who cares.
What matters now is how to punish them for our troubles.
We'll just have them work 100 times harder than usual to make up for it.
You just sat on the sidelines...

Curse those damn humans!
#NAME# and those idiots got in the way of my plans again!
We should have known better than to think Prinnies could make up for our lack of budget from all our failures...
Next time, I'll be sure to get #NAME# and the others to say something!

Wait and see!
Gayahaha!
Sigh... Maybe I should just hand over a written apology.
Yo, Valvatorez, #NAME#. I got what you asked for.
It's the Summoning Jar.

Good work, Adell and Rozalin!
This will save an immense amount of lives!
Yeah, but are you sure this will be enough?
It has withstood all my bullets.
I tried punching and kicking the thing, but it gave no response.
That's why we're using #NAME#'s idea to try and stop them!
#NAME#, I'll use this jar to summon just as you suggested.
"Mega-Beast Counter Professional"!
Right then. Adell.

Got it! I'm counting on you...
Summoning Jar!
Woops, that was dangerous. I should add some sardines as a catalyst.
まてぇーーーーーーーいっ！？

What the-! What was that light?
Is everyone okay?
Eren! Where's Eren?!
I'm right here. Mikasa.
Hold it. Someone's here.
Hey, aren't those guys giant exterminators?

Who are you?
And what is this place?!
A few moments earlier---
That day, Laharl and the others recalled the horrors of being controlled and the humiliation they endured trapped in the Overlord's Castle...
This is no time for a narration!
Doesn't matter who. Just stop them!
Sardines...
That's a massive Prinny. I doubt it'll be stopping anytime soon.
We need to change its course somehow, otherwise it'll storm right into the castle.
冷静に言っている場合か！
But, Laharl. How do you expect us to stop that thing?
My Flonne love punch was just a larger version of Prinny's sardine love.
We're also under orders from His Highness to hold out until his return.
In any case, we have to keep up the resistance.
Dammit! What are Valvatorez and #NAME# doing?
Whoa! Did you hear that explosion just now?

Your Highness!
Your Highness, it's terrible!
What?

Your Highness!
A Colossal Prinny has broken through the wall that Mao had built!
Sardiiines. Sardines are here, dood?
I've made a miscalculation. The wall I created with Nether Enhancement...
Never did I imagine it would be destroyed by a single Colossal Prinny.
Haha... I Would love to get my hands on it and dissect it for myself!

I'll conduct even more research and make it even better!
*Slurp*
Sardines... Give all your sardines, dood!!!

Sardiiines!
All the sardines are mine, dood!
If that Prinny's gotten this big, it might still get even stronger.
His Excellency was also pleased with its growth, but we can't just leave it like this.
It's just a big Prinny. The worst it'll do is destroy the castle. Your Highness, you should escape while there's still time.

Escape?!
I'm scared of no Prinny!
I'm staying right here!

That's right!
Instead of running away, we should be thinking how to capture it!
Protect the castle!

Oh, Flonne.
Can you help me carry the sweets when the castle crumbles?
Sure. I'll put together a hero special effect collection, too!
...Oh boy. I should have followed His Highness as well.
Keheheh... It seems it's all going according to plan.

Look at their panicked faces!
My moment of victory has come at last!
I call it, "Attack of the Prinnies"!
A plan so perfect I surprised even myself!
A few moments earlier---
*sigh* It took all day just to create one. I'm not cut out for late night work, dood...
My Prinnies.
Huh? What do you want, dood?
Who are you callin' kid? Oh, forget it.
You guys seem stressed and frustrated as of late with all this work.

You're right, dood!
This is too much work for us Prinnies!
We deserve at least two sardines a day as an allowance, dood!
If you're feeling frustrated, come to me and I'll give you a good job. Cooperate and you'll have all the sardines in the world.

That sounds fishy!
But I'll do it for sardines, dood!

Keheheh!
Behold, this Colossal Prinny I lured with sardines and created with magic.

I gathered so many I couldn't fit them all into the skin I prepared.
I had to stay up all night sewing them together.
Laharl's castle is filled with sardines. My Colossal Prinny won't stop until it's found every last one.

Now go, Colossal Prinny!
Expel those dammed demons!
Mikasa, Captain Levi. We've been chasing the Titans for quite some time now...

[Eren Jeager] A boy who yearns to explore the world beyond the wall.
After joining the Cadet Corps, he aims for a post in the Scout Regiment who is attempting to expand past the wall.
He is strong-willed and rushes headlong into danger.

Right.
We had just driven them into a corner.

[Mikasa Ackerman] She has been by Eren's side ever since he saved her life when she was a child.
Protecting Eren means everything to her, and she wears the scarf he gave her at all times.
Captain, can you tell us what happened?

How should I know?
Let's just hope we're not in the belly of a Titan itself.

[Levi] He is the squad captain of the Scout Regiment in his own world.
He is widely known as humanity's strongest soldier, and is referred to as "Captain" by his comrades.
After I was blinded by that light, I found myself surrounded by an unfamiliar group. That's all I can tell you.

Who are you people and what do you want?
If you're honest with me, I'll let you go with just your nails off.

Whoa there. What's with the defensiveness?
We just want to ask for your help.
That's right. You're a professional in killing giant monsters, correct?

Giant monsters?
It's true we fight Titans.
If that's what you mean.

Wait, you can't tell?
These are the outfits for the Survey Corps.
You seem confused. Valvatorez, explain what's going on.
Oh, right.
So basically, this super-sized Prinny appeared out of nowhere in this world, and we can't get it under control.
#NAME# came up with a plan to use the Summoning Jar to summon a group who excelled at taking down such monsters.
In other words, us?

...That sounds hard to believe.
Though I'm sure this would drive Hanji crazy.

I don't trust this. Eren, be careful.
This could be a trap.

Are you trying to interfere with our mission?
But what would that get you?
You still don't believe us?

It'd be easier to see for yourself. Eren, was it?
Take a look at that.

Give me sardines!
Dooood!!!
Wh-What the heck is that?!
It's no Titan, but it's just as big...
A silly looking bird?

That's a Prinny.
They atone for their sins through hard labor in this world.
I'm a Prinny trainer. I teach them how to be better in this world.

But that Colossal Prinny you see there...
It's trampling all over the demon world seeking out sardines.
Just like a titan attacking humans.
As a trainer, it hurts me to see a Prinny fall off their path like this.
So I want to stop it and retrain it.
Please help me!
I get that you guys seem not able to control the thing.
But we don't have time to help. We have our own titans to exterminate.
Eren's right. What if one of our friends gets gobbled up while we're wasting time here?
Hey Valvatorez. Hurry up and―
Wait. Someone's coming!

Sardiiines! Where are youuu?
Are you here, dood?
A tiny Prinny?
That there is a normal sized Prinny.
Sardines please, dood!
They're acting really oddly.

I think Mao mentioned it,
that the normal Prinnies are being affected by the magical power emitted by the Colossal Prinny.
So now they're all wandering around looking for sardines.
You better not be hiding them from me, dood! Or else!
Tsk... Annoying creature. Eren, Mikasa. Take care of it.

Lieutenant! Are you sure?
We don't have time to be here!

Standing around doing nothing is no different.
So let's finish that bird then figure out our next plan of action.
...Yes, sir!

Whoa! That was incredible!
It was like you guys were flying!
I've never seen such a strange machine. Seems like a toy Mao would like.
It's equipment that specializes in defeating titans.

You really don't know about ODM gear?
This really isn't our world.
Mikasa, if I wore this, would I be able to fight like you?
...Not right away. It takes years to master the use of it.

That was impressive!
We were right to call you guys!
That technology is exactly what we need to stop that Colossal Prinny!

We didn't agree to anything.
Tell us how to get back to our world.
Oh. You'll probably be sent back after defeating the Colossal Prinny.
You were summoned from this jar... with a contract to stop the Colossal Prinny.
Exactly! So your mission is to stop it!
So, if we defeat the Prinny we'll return home?
Captain?
Tch. Doesn't sound like we have a choice.
Eren, Mikasa, Levi. I'll ask one more time. Will you help us?
If that's the only way to beat it, then we agree.
What about you, Eren?
I don't get what's going on, but if the Captain says that then I guess that's what we do.
If you're lying to us, I'll shred the meat off all of you.

Hahaha...
Well, I can't sit back and watch titans in this world or our world run rampant.
Right then! Let's finish that Colossal Prinny and return to our own world!
Great, now that we're in agreement, let's head to the Overlord's castle and catch up with Fenrich and the others!
Saaardiiineees! Give me sardines, dood!!!
What the! They're all over the place!

It's like they're zombies. Adell, what next?
We'll be stuck here if we don't act.

There's no other choice.
Valvatorez, Rozalin and I will handle this.
Got it. But you better come back alive.

Of course you will!
When we finish up, they're getting a strict scolding!
We're on it!
Eren, let's go.
Yeah. The sooner we finish this the quicker we can get back.
And when I do... I'll exterminate the titans!

#NAME# seems to be up to something.
They've summoned help from another world.
No matter. No human they summoned can take down my super-sized Prinny.

I'll have them all crushed by my Prinny!
Ahahahaha!
And so the fierce (?) battle continues between Eren and others against the Colossal Prinny!
My lord, I bring good news. Eradicating the virus and conquering the upper districts has gained us the support of most demons.
The only stumbling block before us now is the demons lurking in the Palabyrinth of the Corrupternmemt.
We've finally put those corrupt politicians in their place!
When we take back our rule, we'll turn this world to hell and re-educate them. It'll be a sight to see... Keheheh.

Vulcanus, wants to save money, right?
How much are they aiming for?
They're close to reaching their goal. If we can get the money from the president's office at the Central Bank we'll be all set.

Take this more seriously!
Have you forgotten how many troops are stationed there?!

600,000! That's how many!
On top of that, it's an elite force of demons!
It could have been ten million middle class demons and we still wouldn't stand a chance...

What? Only 600,000?
That's no problem if we each take 100,000 of them.

When you're outnumbered, the best way to taken a large army is through surprise and assassination...
But we'll do as you wish.

You expect us alone to overpower 600,000 elites?
That's just insane...
Hey kid. You said you were going to be a full-fledged demon, didn't you? You promised. And now look where we are. In front of the presidential office where your father waits.
This is the time. Show him how much you have grown.

Emizel, you're a boy aren't you?
If you don't get back at your dad for abandoning you here, when will you?

600,000 is nothing compared to Tokyoto's population!
I'll do it!
I'll become president!

...Tsk.
Right. I'll show him how much I've grown!
...Good. That's the spirit.

To the palace then!
We've only got 600,000 to take down!

There's plenty to share!
Let's get going!
Final Episode: Tyrant vs. President of the Netherworld

This is the President's Palace...
It's been a place that's supported the prosperity of demons and humans for thousands of years. But also a city of violence...
Your Highness. Let us open the door. The door to the demise and rebirth of the demon world...
Yes!
My name is Valvatorez! I've come from the depths of Hell to rebuild this demon world corrupted by your negligence!

Our goal is the Political Fist!
But I know this won't happen easily!
So prepare for battle!
We'll crush every last one of you and teach you how to really run this place!
The earth trembled at Valvatorez's name.
The trembling grew louder and louder, and the elite force of 600,000 could be heard shouting.
Gwwwwaaaah!

Why am I not surprised...
Instead of being scared they're getting excited by his name.

Hmph. Maybe that's the only way they can fight. Let's do this!
Everyone!
Valvatorez's party had finally raided the Presidential Palace!
Further ahead, more troops could be seen filling up the area.
But just as Valvatorez was about to rush in and attack...
A sudden explosion blasted the troops away!
Wh-What was that?!
Prinny Tips #6: Don't keep your master waiting. You just barely passed.

Sorry for the wait, My Lord!
A group of heroes have gathered under Lord Valvatorez, dood!

There are 20 million demons on the lower levels!
5 million in the middle!
And 1.3 million on the upper level!

...We are about 100 Prinnies!
You have our full support, dood!
Might not be for me to say, but you should go defeat the president and leave the rest to us, dood!

That's a lot of supporters.
It's normal for a good leader to have a large number, but this is...

...Unbelievable.
This has become a battle against numbers.
It's not their fault, Your Highness. They believe in your dream. That is why they want to help in the fight.
Hmph. Then let's hurry and put an end to their revelry.

Let's go, everyone!
Our target is the President of the Netherworld!
The rest of them don't matter!
Oh? That was surprisingly easy. Emizel's surprise made them seem a lot tougher.
...What do you think, Fenrich?

We aren't up against low-ranking units.
They are in fact the top in the army.
...As I thought. Still they're weaker than I imagined them to be.
But why? It didn't seem like they were holding back either...
Could this be a sign of just how far the Neitherworld's corruption has progressed?
I've been waiting for you, rebels of hell!
I hope you realize the punishment of a Prinny instructor to challenge the President is death!

Th-that's Thunder Emperor Psylos!
He's finally shown himself!
Thunder Emperor Psylos? Who's that?

Thunder Emperor Psylos!
Tromayer the Atrocious!
Baltis the Dreadful!
The Three Heroes of the Netherworld!
When it comes to the number of people they've punished, those three are the ones most feared in the Netherworld and the symbol of fear in the Human World!

Enough wasting time! Tromayer! Baltis!
Execute the traitors!
At Thunder Emperor Psylos' call, the Three Heroes of the Netherworld ready themselves for battle!
The Three Heroes of the Netherworld... There never seems to be an end to guys like these nowadays.

It's natural you wouldn't know about them.
They're just a bunch of kids who scored points with the President while you've been away.
But I won't stand back and let these idiots put up high airs around you, my Lordship.
Hmph... Then we'll just have to teach them a lesson. That's what fighting is all about.

Ngh! Impossible!
No one defeats the Three Heroes of the Netherworld!

You only got that title because Lord Valvatorez wasn't around!
Know your place!
And while we're at it, know that Death Emizel has risen again from a false death.

That glowing skull on your forehead...
That's the mark of Death Emizel!

That's right!
I'm Death Emizel!

...N-no! That's even less convincing!
There's no way you're the real Lord Emizel!
Less convincing?!
Despite being the President's son, Death Emizel is known to be a total slacker...
It's a joke that he would become a rebel strong enough to defeat the Three Heroes of the Netherworld!
The Three Heroes of the Netherworld have retreated!
You've become so strong no one believes it's really you. What's happened to this world?
Give me a break!
Kid. Don't tell me you're giving up after one battle?

Your father has fought and won much far more battles than this.
Aren't you here to prove yourself to him?

Ignore those other demons.
What matters is that you keep on fighting until your father finally approves of you.
You're right... I shouldn't let something like this get me down.

Okay!
I don't care what others think!
I'll tell them a thousand times if I have to!

I'm Death Emizel!
The real Death Emizel!
Hmph. No point in exclaiming it here. If you wanna scream, do it in front of your father.

...Did I just hear you right?
So you do have a kind side to you.
Never thought I actually see a tsundere in real life.

...That's not it.
It's my job to raise the morale of my allies if it benefit's his Lordship.
I'm not some tsundere.
...If anything, I'm the furthest one here to be ever called that!
Hmph... Don't get full of yourselves just for defeating the Netherworld's three biggest idiots.
If you had just lived in the depths of Hades, you wouldn't have died... Fools.

It's Garatea of the East!
This time it's the Four Devas of the Netherworld!

Garatea of the East!
Arsailles of the West!
Graceus of the South!

And Reprachon of the North!
It's said that if the four were to ever come together, the world would be doomed!
Didn't you say something similar against the Three Heroes of the Netherworld?
Come! Arsailles! Graceus! Reprachon!

Unleash the power of the Four Devas of the Netherworld!
You traitors will pay for your actions with your death!
Responding to Garatea of the East's call, the Four Devas of the Netherworld attack!

Hmph! I don't care if you're the Three Heroes or the Four Devas of the Netherworld!
I'll crush anyone who stands in my way!
Come at us! We'll show you that numbers mean nothing in battle!

W-We actually did it!
We defeated the Three Heroes and the Four Devas of the Netherworld!
I really have become stronger... This is proof of my growth!
...That was too easy. Did they honestly think joining forces would guarantee a victory?

Sir Fenrich!
I'm here to report, dood!
Good work. What's the status of the war?
The demons who've joined us in every region have proven to be dependable in battle, dood.
Their strength comes from their numbers, but they won't be able to hold up if it prolongs, dood.
Then we shouldn't waste any more time... Let's get a move on!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text: Rebels. This is as far as you'll go.
Not again... Who are we up against this time?

That's the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld!
It's said they can destroy the world within the same seven days it took God to create it!

We're up against seven now, death?!
Their numbers just keep increasing, death!
There's no point in introductions anymore. It's just getting sloppy...

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text: Tell me... how much do you want this?

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Your actions have brought the Netherworld into an uproar.
This forsaken rebellion of yours is going against the President's wishes.
Are they trying to haggle with us?

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Is there a problem?
If it's status you want, I can grant you as one of the Three Heroes or Four Devas that you defeated.
Don't make me laugh!
What interest would I have in status of a corrupt government?! I'm here to restore the Netherworld to its original state! Demons and humans alike will be re-educated!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
I should be saying the same to you!
As if some Prinny instructor knows anything!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text: You talk about corruption, but do you have any idea just how weary the President has grown about this world?!
Dad? He's weary?

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Dad? Who do you think you are?!
Lord Emizel is already dead!
No! He's not dead! I'm him! Alive and well!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Then why are you interfering with the President?!
You'll throw the entire Netherworld into chaos!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
I can care less if you're alive or dead!
You should have just stayed in Hell!
Why join the rebels?! What are you after?!

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Did the rebels threaten you?
Or is this your means of revenge for His Highness for deserting you?
I'm not after revenge... I just...
Listen, you!
Being one of the Seven Yakshas doesn't give you the right to talk down to him like that!
What's so wrong about a kid seeking out his own father's approval?!
If it weren't for the corruption and misinformation, he wouldn't have needed to become a rebel in the first place!
Fuka... You...

Well said, little girl.
You're the ones who tried bribing us first, and now you're taking it out on a kid?
It's because of corrupt creatures like you that rebels like me exist. Why don't you think this way?

The President might feel displeased with the Netherworld, but it's far from functioning as it should be.
We shouldn't be making excuses for his failure to rule.
A government that can't keep its promises and is full of corruption should ultimately be destroyed.

And what about you, thieving angel?
You're here to pilfer money, aren't you?
Won't this work against you?

I'm only here to collect what I need.
I have no intention to sell my soul away.

chara3_name: One of the Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Not interested in negotiating then, huh?
Fine. I'll just kill you here!
Something's not right... The Seven Yakshas of the Netherworld shouldn't be this powerful.

First the Three Heroes, then the Four Devas, now the Seven Yakshas?
There's no doubt something fishy is going on here.

Do you think the bribery was on my father's orders?
But the way they made him sound...
We won't know until we ask him. Worrying about it won't get us anywhere.
You're right. I won't run away anymore!
Good. That's the spirit, rascal.

Um... Big Sis?
Do you also wanna meet your dad, death?

Wh-where did that come from?
O-Of course not!
What kind of awful father wouldn't come home on his own daughter's birthday?
Day after day he'd push me away just so he could be alone with his dear research... He could go to Hell for all I care!

...Anyway! We need to get to the President's chair!
Let's move, Desco!
Y-Yes, Big Sis!

We're almost there!
All we have to do is get past here, and we'll reach my father in no time!
The time has come. Soon we'll regain our power and political rule. And from there, an even greater undertaking will begin.

The Netherworld and the Human World will both become hell realms!
I can already tell the reeducation of dissenters will be no easy task.
Don't you agree, Fenrich?
Lord Val! Watch out!
Fenrich suddenly shoves his lord out of the way. A crazy avalanche of magic proceeds to thunder right into him!
—Gwwaaah!
Fenrich takes the hit, dropping to his knees!
Fenrich!

chara3_name: One of the Ten Asura Kings of the Netherworld
talk_text: Heh heh heh! You're not putting a paw past us!
It can't be! The Ten Asura Kings of the Netherworld?!

The worst ten demons in existence!
Responsible for almost every crappy thing that ever happened!
These guys are the pits!

chara3_name: One of the Ten Asura Kings of the Netherworld
talk_text:
I'm amazed to see you still breathing after getting hit by a patented Ten Kings Attack!
You may say your farewells before we finish you off!
My lord... Thank goodness that didn't hit you...
Valvatorez gathers the fallen Fenrich into his arms!
Fenrich is fading fast, his breathing shallow and weak.
Fenrich!
I'm happy, my lord... to be able to repay you... here at the last...

I'm not accepting payment like this!
I will not permit this kind of death scene!
I know when my time has come... and it's knocking right now...
But, before I open that door... please, at the end... drink my blood...
What? Has the pain driven you mad?!

I might have mentioned... that I'm a werewolf. If you drink my blood...
it should temporarily restore your magic...
Please, Lord Val... while I yet live, drink from me... Let me see you restored to glory, one final time!

Is your memory dying first, Fenrich?
I never break my promises!
I will never drink your blood!
Lord Val...
The only thing you're going to see is a noble demon who keeps his word!
I would expect no less, My Lord. You are always... one step ahead of me...
A faint smile curves Fenrich's lips.
Then Fenrich jumps smoothly back onto his feet!
If you will not drink my blood, my lord, then I can't very well die here.

chara3_name: One of the Ten Asura Kings of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Huh? What the wakka-wakka?
How's he standing up again?!

Another ploy to get me to drink your blood foiled, Fenrich!
You mangy dog!

We will discuss this later.
But now you're going to have to pay the price for underestimating my resolve!
Pay it by defeating these ten dumb dudes!

You leave me little choice, as always.
All is for my lord!

chara3_name: One of the Ten Asura Kings of the Netherworld
talk_text:
Bah! You're still not getting past us!
We will protect the President with everything we've got!
I'm going to need that explanation now, Fenrich.
Why did you pretend to be dying, just to get me to drink your blood?
The answer is simple, my lord. I wanted you as strong as possible prior to the encroaching presidential battle.
It also would have served as a fitting thank you for you originally saving my life. Regrettably, the strength of your convictions flummoxed my ploy.

Hah! Trying to trick me, even while the crap hits the conveyor-belt?
That's my minion.
You sly dog!

I take your words as the highest praise, my lord.
All I do is in your service.

Hey, Desco! Did we just hear some hints of an exciting backstory?
Like some kind of life debt being owed?

Desco's curious, Big Sis!
Desco would love to hear more, death!
Then the three of us should collaborate in this endeavor. What do you say?

A secret pact between three young women?
I like it! Ohohoho!
Ohohoho!
You have done well to make it here alive, you brave but foolish rebels.
...Father.

Who doesn't want to meet the president?
Or should I say—Death King Hugo!
There you are, Valvatorez. I admit, I was surprised when the first reports informed me that you, of all demons, were leading this little rebellion.
What? You know my father?!
We fought once. A long time ago. A long fight, too, but after nights of pitched battle... we were left standing at a stalemate.
Enough reminiscing. I need answers, Death King Hugo!

What's all this about?
You were once more passionate about spreading fear in the Human World than any demon I knew!

Why are you imprisoning innocent demons?
Why do you let humans run amok?
What's happening between the two worlds?

Letting humans run amok?
So that's how this appears to you.

And the rest of you rabble, you are in agreement with Valvatorez?
Have you all come for my head?

De-Desco's here to defeat you!
Defeat the President and become the Final Boss, death!
I'm only here to collect the unregulated monies flowing into the Netherworld. The clues led me here. Nothing more.

I want to be President!
I'm running on a platform of beating your ass and giving Prinnys all the tax breaks they like!

And what about you, boy?
Have you come to enact your glorious revenge, Emizel?

No. Not at all. I just want to prove that I've grown.
That I can stand on my own two feet!
That I've become a demon worthy of being your son, father!

And you, wolfman?
I sense your hand behind this smoothly orchestrated rebellion.

Any strategy I provided only succeeded due to my lord's persistence and drive.
I take credit for none of this.
As for my personal goal in all this... that is a secret. I see no reason to share it with you.

I see. Hah, haha!
Gahahahaha!

Look at you fools! Not a shred of agreement among you!
How has this rabble brought my Corrupternment so low?
You're not wrong, Prez. We agree about almost nothing. But there's still something that binds us together.
It's not about intent or goals. You're swimming in the shallows, thinking like that. I'm talking a deeper, stronger bond.
The bond of friendship, forged by all the battles we've been through to get here!

We're different races, living different lives!
Nothing connected our histories before we met!

But our friendship binds us tightly together!
With a bond that no presidential decree can break!

You've changed, Valvatorez. You were a loner!
Feared as a tyrant!
Now you're spouting this dime-store "power of friendship" claptrap?
This is an even bigger surprise than when I found out you were behind all this!

Hah. I'm evolving, day by day!
To keep my promise with Sardine!
Huh!

Now I know you're phoning it in!
Very well! My presidential powers will decide if that is evolution or regression!
Massive magical power swells up, transforming the President of the Netherworld!

I'm right here, Prez!
As a bonus, we can finally settle our fight!
I'll prove I'm stronger!

No wonder they call you "Tyrant Valvatorez"!
But you've still not recovered your full strength!

Everyone, stand firm!
He's only toying with us!
Heh heh. Keep your cape on.

You just experienced all of my magic.
I don't have any power left to transform.

Why? What happened to you, father?
Your magic was always so powerful!
How have you run out already?

Explain yourself, Death King Hugo!
The Seven Yakshas sucked, we totaled the Ten Kings, and now the president is a pushover!
What's going on?
I've lost much of my magic. I can't reach my second transformation, let alone my final form. Just like you, Valvatorez!
Ah. The issues with Fear Energy.
Fear Energy?
It's the energy emitted when humans fear the darkness.
The fear of humans is a fundamental force, supporting the Netherworld and the demons who live here.
The opposing force is Respect Energy. That's generated by human devotion to Heaven.
The Respect of humans provides those of us who serve Heaven with strength and courage.
But humans began to turn their "science" into weapons, greatly reducing the Fear Energy that reaches us.
If humans fear other humans, that energy stays in the Human World.
Wars, terrorism, weapons of mass destruction, tragedies caused by human error, and every day another murder.
Humans hold all the Fear Energy now. There's no stopping our regression.
The supply of Fear to the Netherworld has been completely severed.

Completely?! That means more than just demons getting weaker!
The entire Netherworld will fold in on itself!
For better or worse, humans are highly interested in research into demons. So they made me a proposal.

The terms were simple.
The Human World supplies us with Fear Energy, and I allow them to conduct demon research.
That's where... Desco comes from, death?!
If I turned it down, they would have taken what they wanted by force, or just let the lack of energy finish us off. In either case, that's the end of the Netherworld.

Father!
I had no idea of any of this.
Look what I've been doing... with all this going on!

The amount of Fear Energy flowing into the Netherworld is currently being tightly controlled.
And that brings you up to date.
It's true. For all intents and purposes, the Netherworld has already been taken—and by a single human.
What? No!

What kind of joke is this?
A single human has taken the entire Netherworld?!
Look at this! So pathetic!
Why is it, whenever the big bad is defeated, they feel compelled to spill their guts about all that juicy secret stuff?
Hey! Who're you?
A judge, perchance, born to adjudicate over the sins of humanity. You may call me Judge Nemo, if you like.
Judge Nemo?
You're looking at the sole owner of Fear Energy. The human dictator who currently holds the entire Netherworld in his grasp.

Well, Valvatorez—if that's your name.
Having defeated El Presidente makes you top dog in the underworld.
I hear you intend to plunge the Human World and the Netherworld into Hades?
...Indeed.

Bravo!
A most wonderful conceit, Valvatorez.
And you know what—it's the exact same idea as me!

I'm planning on sending the world to Hades too!
Can you believe that coincidence?
What!?

What do you say, Valvatorez?
If we have the same goals, then why not join forces?

Let's send the world to Hades together!
Destroy everything, just really trash it all!

Now I know you're joking!
My goal isn't to destroy the world.
I want to bring discipline to humans and demons!
I'll turn the world into Hades, disciplining the humans and demons who fall, and restoring the true order!
Hades is a place of training. Somewhere sins are atoned for, prior to rebirth!

I'll never join forces with someone who believes Hades is for destruction!
Pure foolishness!

So you would stand against me?
Even if I cut off your Fear Energy?
Even if you know you can't hope to defeat me?
Even without Fear Energy, I still have Sardine Energy. I don't remember bending the knee to you, either!
..I see. A demon of principle. Then I invite you to the Human World. You seem to need me to spell out just how hopeless your position is.
You can't hope to defeat me.

Hehehehe...
Ah-hahahaha!

Just you wait, Nemo—if that's your name!
I'll make you regret suddenly showing up here with that Final Boss look on your human face!

Hey! Hold on!
Who gets to be president?

We did defeat the old one.
I guess I can do it?
No objections?

Pitiful peon! Of course I have objections!
My lord Valvatorez is the only possible president!

It's hardly the time for this!
If you want the position, you can have it.
First come first served!
No way! That's not how we're doing this!

Okay! You twisted my arm!
I'll become president!
Warden Axel! You're still alive?!
Of course! I'm basically invulnerable!

Open up those ears!
I'm no fake! I'm the real, one-and-only, authentic and original Axel!
My true purpose was to shape the Netherworld in my own incredible image!

But the Corrupternment feared my raw charisma!
They captured me, and locked me away in Hades!

I never gave up.
Not for one single day.
I ingratiated myself with the Corrupternment, finally rising to the rank of Warden!

And now! Finally! All my hard work will pay off!
First come first served! Serve me!

...Sure thing. That's settled.
You are now the 62nd President of the Netherworld.
Axel was appointed 62nd President of the Netherworld!

Kaboom! I'm the boss!
We've had our fair share of trouble, but that's all water under the bridge!
Go on! You can leave the Netherworld to me and toddle off to the Human World!
While you guys are gone, I'm going to completely reshape the Netherworld! Yehaaaw!

Huh? Is that it?
That decided the president? Really?

I know we half-ass everything, but I can't believe this!
That dumbbell gets to be president?
It really is the end times!

Ah, I get it! Now I understand!
This is a dream where I get to rule the Human World!

That's it. That has to be it!
We just need to defeat that horrible little Nemo goblin guy, right?
"Judge Nemo", Big Sis. That's what he called himself, death!
Even the guy who controlled my father and rules the Human World is just a "goblin guy" to her.
If you're willing to fight the Judge, I don't care about your motivations. Put your back into it, girl.

You bet I will!
Once I rule the Human World, I'm going to turn every pop singer in the world into my own personal Prinnys!

Come on, everyone!
Time to get to work!

Ubleh!
What's with this horrible air?
It reeks!
Environmental pollution seems pretty serious. Dirtying up the very air they breathe! Foolish creatures! Hardly worth saving.
Wow! It's been a while!
Breathing this polluted smog takes Desco back to the day she was discarded, death!
Discarded, huh. You've certainly been through a lot.
But you're always so bright and cheerful, even in the face of these burdens.

Hehe. Of course, Desco was discarded because she was too weak to be the Final Boss.
It's Desco's own fault, death.

Getting cast into Hades was how Desco met you, Big Sis, and how she become so much stronger.
Desco's actually been very lucky, death.

Stronger, you say?
Surely you aren't satisfied with the pitiful level you've reached?

Of course not!
Desco will become the mightiest Final Boss in history, and finally get the stamp of approval from you and Big Sis!

Good! That's the spirit!
Our next goal is to put the gavel to Judge Nemo!
This is also vital Final Boss training!

Desco's got this, death!
Desco's gonna do her best!
The road to becoming the Final Boss marks Desco's destiny!
Desco is feeling so pumped up, she claps her hands in front of her!
Woooooaaaaah!!
Responding to her energy, some demon appears!

The perfect opponent to start Desco's training, death!
Let the slaughter commence, death!

...Hold on!
Why are there demons on Earth?!
This must be Judge Nemo's doing as well. Go ahead, squish them!

What's wrong, rascal?
Worried about your father?
No need to tag along if there's other things on your mind.
I'm not going back to my father.

Why not?
You couldn't make up?

No, that wasn't an issue.
He didn't abandon me after all.

Disappointed in me, Emizel?
Your father, ruler of the Netherworld, a puppet of the humans all along?
No, that's not it either—although that was surprising.
The cowardly Corrupternment never felt exactly like my father's doing, but I didn't expect a human to be pulling the strings.
I'm sorry, Emizel. I know I made your life hard, but as President I had to protect the Netherworld.
And as your father, I had to protect you. That's why I pushed you away from the presidential circle, where the human influence was strongest.
I know it just sounds like excuses, but it was all I could think to do.
I'm the one who should be apologizing.

I not only failed to meet your expectations, but didn't even realize the issues you were wrestling with!
I'm so sorry.
We can talk more when I return, father.
You're going with them, Emizel?
Yes. Returning the Netherworld to its true form seems to require some correction in the Human World first.
In addition, that Nemo guy has caused so much trouble for you, and the rest of the Netherworld. He needs to pay for that.
Once everything is resolved, then I'll finally be able to start working toward my true goal—becoming President of the Netherworld.

So? What happened?
Did your dad get all teary eyed and tell you what a wonderful demon you've become?
None of your business!
I've got a greater purpose now. To become President of the Netherworld!
Once we've defeated Nemo and put things right between the Netherworld and the Human World—
Netherworld President Axel had better get ready for an ass-kicking!

Oooh! What was that?
Like someone walking over my grave—or planning to throw me into it!

Don't tell me! My biggest fan has become my biggest stalker!
I sense misery in my future!

Hehehe! Which means my plan is coming along nicely!
It's not easy being popular, I can tell you!
Where are we?
I don't have GPS, my lord, but I am pretty sure this is somewhere in the Human World.
Judge Nemo is clearly expecting us. Look at the welcome wagon.
Hey! What are they doing here?
Fuka, you know what those things are?
Sure do. Multi-purpose bio-suits, codenamed "Zodiac".

Super-duper weapons of death!
Armor that can withstand a landslide of landmines while boosting the wearer's strength 500 times!

Put a baby in one of those things, it will still clean the clock of your average demon!
Tick, tick, tick, boom!

I can't believe it!
The light of knowledge, glowing from Fuka's brain!

Desco understands your shock, but please be nicer to Big Sis, death.
For me, Emizel.
There's a reason she knows about all this stuff—

Enough talking!
Here they come!
Get ready to fight them!
Desco's played with these things before, death. Desco's not gonna lose to those bio-suits now!
What? When you say "played with", what exactly does that mean?

When Desco was in the lab, she was tested by fighting these things. Pretty fun!
You just smash them until they stop moving, death.
The lab? You were in that same lab?!
Y-Yes, death...
Which means—you're the one who attacked me!

No, that's not what Desco means, death!
It wasn't Desco! Believe me, Big Sis!

I mean... I'd like to... So who was it?
Who attacked me?

Hold a moment.
If we're asking questions, I've got some too...
Tell me, girl, exactly what you know.
Desco was created by humans, so it's not surprising that she'd come into contact with these weapons—humans made them too.
But it's super suspicious, Fuka, that your blank-slated smooth brain recalls those bio-suits in such detail.
They were... something to do with my dad's work, I think...

Which means—Fuka's father and Desco?
There's some kind of connection there?

No! Never!
You think my dad made Desco?
That's impossible, I promise!
We'll find out how impossible it is, soon enough.
First things first, anyway. Someone has been listening in, and it's time to take him out.

Hehehe. Welcome to Earth!
The realm of debauched chaos.
Like moths to the flame, you flutter unknowingly before the Judge!

You're the "unknowing" one, if you think that little army you put together back there was enough to defeat us!
Didn't "judge" that one well, did you?

Oh please. That was but a test.
If you can't make it through that, there's no point wasting time on you.

But you passed.
Allow me to welcome you, officially, as my guests.
This time I'll give you the works, no expense spared.

Come along now, keep it moving!
The customer holds all the cards!
Allow me to welcome you properly!
Big Sis...

Please, you have to believe Desco!
Desco would never, never attack you!
Enough of that. Get moving!
Big Sis...
I want to believe Desco. I really do...
But who was it who attacked me?

Oh, this is bad!
I'm just without the slightest clue!
Well then. What have you got for us next, Judge Nemo?

Proof, is my next exhibit.
Undeniable proof that the Human World doesn't require demons.
Judge Nemo gives a loaded smile, and suddenly a horde of demons appear!
What's with all these demons?!
These aren't demons. Not as you know them. One might call them—clone demons.
Clone demons?! Impossible!

These are man-made demons!
Created using science from demon cells received as part of my deal with the Corrupternment!
You're not going to say my dad made these demons too, are you?

This is my dream, right?
So it can't have such a twist!
It's impossible!

Isn't this fun, Valvatorez?
Humans have completely surpassed demons, as you can see. Now do you understand?
Demons don't have the power to discipline mortals any more. I'm the only one who can make humans feel fear! The only one who can judge them!

You think clone demons can replace the real thing?
Hilarious!

I'm about to show you what a real demon can do!
In fact, we all are!

My, my. You guys are good!
I can see why Hugo couldn't handle you. Fighting you is fun!

If I analyze your strength, I'll be able to make some even more powerful demons.
I owe you my thanks!

You call those clones "demons"? That's just a sick joke!
They are killing machines, nothing more!

Demons exist to discipline humans using fear!
The emissaries of darkness, bound by that sacred mission!

Discipline through fear?
Emissaries of darkness?
I'm amazed you can stomach spouting such nonsense!

I've seen what demons do, and it's nothing!
Exactly nothing at all!

Where were you when humans really needed to be stopped by you?
When your precious "discipline" could have made all the difference?

Those who should be saved perish and die, and those who deserve death live and prosper!
That's the world we live in!
What have you ever done for it?
Okay. You're really starting to lose me now.
It's too late to show up and start playing the "oh but we're demons" card now. Far too late!
Humans don't need to be put back on the correct path. They need to regret their mistakes, despair, and then get destroyed!
I think this guy just has a screw loose.

...You want to wipe all of humanity out, do you?
What grudge could you hold that's so powerful?
A grudge? You think such a petty word can hold my pain and suffering?!
...Humans deserve death. It's that simple.
God, angels, demons—if none of you are going to execute that sentence, then I'll have to pull the lever myself!

You claim to rule the Earth, but want to wipe its people out?
Pathetic!
You know nothing of rule!

Please!
There's no need to go this far!
Humans aren't as far gone as you think!

Maybe you're right. I know nothing of ruling.
But I've become ruler, so maybe now I define what that means.
I only reached this point as a result of my pursuit of the power to eradicate humanity.
Huh?!
Hey. Did he just blank Artin—ahem, Vulcanus completely there?

Very well. I've got plans within plans!
I'll just move on to the next one.
That Nemo guy... I don't think he can see angels.

He can't?
There was at least one of them right in front of him.
He hates this world so much, he's lost his faith completely.
Those of use who serve Heaven subsist on Respect Energy, drawn from the faith in human hearts.
God and the angels protect and watch over those who hold powerful faith. At times, we can even show ourselves to them.
But for those without such faith—
You don't do anything. Don't even show up.
Judge Nemo. The man who denies demons and doesn't believe in angels.

Oh, dad... We're okay, aren't we?
You really aren't the one who made Desco?
But after mom died, you threw yourself into your work. Hardly ever left the lab.
If those bio-suits and clone demons are made with your technology...
Are you okay, Big Sis?
...I'm sorry. I don't know what to say to you right now.
Big Sis...
Oh wow!

I can't believe it!
You came back all on your own?
That's amazing, Final Weapon Desco!
Uwah hah hah!
Dad!

...Hold on. You just said "dad" too, didn't you?
Why? This is my dad!
Yes, Desco knows... That's why you're Desco's Big Sis, death.
Oh... uhhhh…
Ugaaaaaaayh!

Hey! What's wrong, girl?
Your head finally sprung a leak?

I can't believe this!
Someone explain! My dad really did create Desco?
The Final Boss, intended to wipe out humanity?

Tell me, girl. Just who is your father?
Someone capable of creating Desco seems worth of my attention.

Dad is a human with one of the smartest brains on the entire planet, death!
His official job title is mad scientist!

What are you playing at, dad?
Have you joined up with this Nemo creep?
You've become an evil minion, seeking to wipe out the world?

Huh? I thought you were just a girl with a weird hat on, but Fuka!
It's you.

Fuka, huh. And why are you alive?
Didn't you go to Hades?
Hey! Nice way to treat your daughter!
Come on. We all know you aren't Heaven material.

Gaaah! You're crazy!
I'm not even dead!
Why are you saying I'm dead?!
I mean, you are. No doubt about it.
Look. A scientific opinion. This finally proves that you're actually dead.
Come, girl. Time to keep your promise. Starting today, I'm going to thoroughly train you—as a Prinny!

No!
This is a dream! A nightmare!
This has to be some kind of mistake!

My dad is helping to wipe out humanity?
This has to be a dream!

I can't believe you're an evil scientist, dad!
You made Desco and the bio-suits and the clone demons too, didn't you!

That's right!
Did you like them?
I think they turned out pretty swell!
But there's also room for improvement. This Fear Energy deprived rabble of demons shouldn't be beating them.

You there. Indulge my scientific curiosity.
Just why are you so strong?
Hahaha, the answer is simple—

Hehehe! Sorry to interrupt, but it's time to continue the fun.
Shall we prepare for the main event?
Understood. Everything is ready to go.

As impeccable as ever, Professor Kazamatsuri!
Taking the time to headhunt you has paid off!
Oh, this is nothing. I just needed your money to achieve my own goals.

We're all using each other for our own ends.
No need to be nice.

So calculating, Professor!
And I love your calculations. Keep at it!

Dad! Why have you joined up with that creep?
What are you trying to do?
What is it you want, dad?!
I can't tell you that. Not yet. But you'll understand soon enough.

Hey! Hold it!
Don't you dare run away from me!
You absentee parental figure!
...He's your dad, that's for sure. Unfathomable.
Still, there's a silver lining to all this. You and Desco actually are sisters—after a fashion!

That does seem to be the case.
Whether that's a good thing or not, well...
Big Sis...

I'm sorry, Desco. You got made, and then told you're the Final Boss, or a weapon for killing...
That must have been so hard.
I'm sorry. Look at all the crap my crappy dad has put you through...

It's fine! No need to worry, Big Sis!
It wasn't hard on Desco at all, death!
If you accept Desco as your kid sister, that's all I could ask for!
Hehe. Good for you, Desco!

Hold on!
I still don't know anything about the one who attacked me, though!
I'm guessing their "main event" is going to explain that.
You are? Why would you think such a thing?
Because that's when revealing it would be the most dramatic!
Wow, okay. I'm disgusted by how persuasive that sounds.

Dad!
What are you doing this time?

I'm a movie buff, what can I say.
You know that long-running series of movies that involve reviving dinosaurs via their DNA?
Well that's where I got the idea for clone demons from.

Then I gathered even more powerful DNA from those clones, and used it to make our next main feature!
Our star-studded attraction!

The Ultimate Final Weapon!
The true Final Boss!
This is it. Finally, after everything, this time has come, death.

Final Weapon Deco, Perfect Grade Edition, death!
Her name - Des X!
So this is their big play. The true Final Boss!
...She looks just like Desco.

Hah. I thought you were calling me for a challenge?
Look at this.
I've killed at least two of these losers already.

You really want to get in my way that badly?
Or do you just want me to kill you again?

Which one is it?
Desco! Fuka!
What?!

I see, so it was you.
It wasn't Desco who attacked me—it was you!

That's right!
I killed you, with these two hands right here!

I'm not dead!
Look! I'm alive and well!
You don't even know you're dead. What an eyesore!
Very well. I'll kill you as many times as it takes!

Shut it! I'm definitely not dead and this is all a dream!
You can't kill me!

That's right! Desco is right here with you, Fuka!
Desco won't let anyone kill you, death!

Hehe. You've got a mouth on you, Desco. Have you forgotten how you couldn't keep up when we fought before?
How I trashed you so easily?

You're a prototype!
Created only as part of the process of reaching me!

It doesn't matter how strong you think you are!
You don't have a 1% chance of defeating me!
That's not—

Not true at all!
Desco is my mighty kid sister!
I'm going to rule the Human World, and my sister is going to be the most powerful Final Boss!
Our golden, gorgeous combination can't be defeated by the likes of you!
B-Big Sis!
