keep my guard up.

An evil soul... I
see—so that’s the root
cause of “Halloween”...!

An evil soul... So that’s
the root cause of “Halloween”...!

Raspberyl. Do you have
any idea where that
evil soul might be?

If I knew that, I wouldn't be
having such a hard time, though.

It's possible someone is possessed. I guess
we'll just have to check everyone who
seems a little off, one by one.

I see... There are this many people. Checking them one
by one is going to be a real pain.

That's why we gatekeepers are here.
…Sorry, but I've got to
get back to work now.

What are you going to do, Izuna?
Are you going to run all over
the venue looking for the culprit, Plip?

……Well, I guess
so. For now—

Please, won't you let
me into the venue?

Plip? Looks like someone's having a
fight at the entrance. I'm gonna
go check it out, Plip!

Guns are prohibited at the Halloween venue. I'm
sorry, but I can't let you through.

This gun is a precious keepsake of mine.
Could you please let it slide this once?

That's right, Raspberyl! You
know Rosa-rin wouldn't do
anything dangerous, don't you?

……Sorry about that. Even if it’s someone
I know, rules are rules. As the
gatekeeper, I can’t make any exceptions.

Wait, Raspberyl! That girl from the Nine-Tailed
Clan isn't a villain! For my sake,
please let her into the venue!

Are you going to stick up for Rozalin,
too? Are you two buddies or something?

No, I don't know him! This
is the first time we've met!

How can you be so sure
that Rozalin isn't the villain!?

It's a given... because I myself
believe that there are no
villains among the Nine-Tailed Clan!

There are no villains among the Nine-Tailed
Clan! Because that’s what I believe!

No matter how you look at it, that's prejudice!
How can you say that with such confidence!?

Uh, excuse me... you there. I know you just
protected me, so I feel bad saying this, but...

"This is just a costume, you know. I'm
not actually part of the Nine-Tailed Clan—"

Shhh! Rosarin! Whatever the
reason, that lady’s on
our side, isn’t she?

Since we're already here, let's
just keep quiet about it.

How many times do I have to tell you?
Bringing dangerous items to the Halloween venue is absolutely
forbidden. Guns are completely out of the question.

This is important for
keeping Halloween alive!

"Protect 'Halloween'…?" You can't be
serious… Are you an 'enemy'!?

"Enemy"? What are
you talking about?

Hey, girls! I'll handle
this! You guys
go on ahead!

Lucky me!
Thanks, stranger!
…………Well, I suppose that works out well.

Hey, hey! Don't just
barge in like that!

Wait! I'm the one
you're up against!

Huh... So you're willing to act as a
decoy just to save a complete stranger...?
You seem like quite the "bad guy"!

I like this! Let's bet
on who's the real "badass"
and have a one-on-one showdown!

I don't know anything about "the Bad
Guy"... but if you say you're my
"enemy," then I'll take you on!

You said your name was Izuna, right?
It’s been a while since I’ve
had such a satisfying one-on-one fight.

Me too. From Raspberyl's fist,
I could tell that you
aren't the real "enemy."

And I’ve come to understand that “Halloween” isn’t some kind of
evil ritual after all. I never would have guessed it
wasn’t about turning into monsters, but just about dressing up.

I'm glad you get it. Halloween is something
we all enjoy together. That's exactly why
I can't let those evil guys slide.

I see. But if someone as powerful as
Raspberyl is guarding the gate, evil spirits shouldn't
be able to get in that easily.

Still, it was surprising to see Lucy get so flustered
when she heard she was the “source of the trouble”...

Security seems tighter than usual, and I
get the feeling that something's a little
off about Halloween this year. Plip.

Actually, it seems a threat has been sent
to the Halloween venue. It says, “I’m
going to take everything in the Netherworld.”

A threat to commit a crime!?
Who on earth did that, Plip?

That's what I don't get. According to the
Prinnys who read the warning letter, it
seems there aren't any clues at all...

Maybe we should take a look
at the real thing. Hey, Prinny!
Bring me that crime warning!

This is a threat. It's the first
time I've seen the real thing, too.

Even though he was the gatekeeper,
didn't he see the threat?

The security team was really busy, you see.
I left it to the Prinnys to check
what was inside. Let me see now……
Is this the work of the Immovable Strategist Higan?!

Even though they went out of their way
to write their name, how come no one
knew who the culprit was until now, Plip!?

……I’d forgotten that the Prinnys can’t
read difficult kanji. They only told
me the gist of it.

But now we know exactly who
we need to watch out for!

Ah! Let's capture that strategist Higan
and protect Halloween and all
the sweets in the Netherworld!

According to what I heard from some
Halloween participants, there are reports that someone
spotted the Strategist Higan around here.

Look—there’s a long line of demons
forming over there. What on
earth is that line for?

This is the line to offer
sweets to Military Strategist Higan.

Offering sweets? So does that mean the
person at the front of the
line is Military Strategist Higan-san, Plip?

Strategist Higan! I brought
you some snacks!
Please accept them!

Hehe, you sure brought it. Well
then, time to show your butt.
Here we go—Trick or Treat!!

Whoa!! …Ahh, I'm
so happy!

The participants who got their butts spanked
are all heading home looking satisfied… I
wonder what’s so fun about that.

If you guys give me some candy,
I'll spank you myself, you know?

Fine! But more importantly… What on earth
is your goal, this so-called Strategist
Higan, in causing all this commotion?!

It's just as you can see. People who want me
to play tricks on them keep coming one after
another. I grant their wishes in exchange for sweets.

Strategist Higan is happy to get some candy.
The participants are happy to get their
bottoms spanked. It’s truly a win-win, Plip.

That doesn't matter at all!
What I want to know
is about this threat!

……What is this? I don't remember
writing a threat like this.

I knew it. I thought it was weird
that the culprit would go out of
their way to leave their name behind.

So, that means there's another culprit out
there impersonating the military strategist Higan.

So, does that mean we're back to Plip
in the search for the culprit? Maybe
we should just cancel Halloween for now—

……Call it off? You
lot, surround these people!

chara2_name: Subordinates of the Immovable Strategist Higan
talk_text:
Whoa! You lot, don't
move an inch!

What the—!? What are you up to
all of a sudden, Strategist Higan!?

Hehe… Trick or treat. If you don’t
give me some candy, I’m going
to play a trick on you!

What do you think you're doing,
surrounding us like this?! Strategist Higan!

This Halloween celebration is wonderful. Sweets
just keep coming one after another.
I’ve really grown to love it.

To stop Halloween? Absolutely not! Anyone who tries
to take sweets away from me will face
the wrath of the Immovable Strategist Higan!

Ugh, it's because you eat nothing but sweets that you've
got such a flabby belly! I'll teach you a lesson
so harsh that you'll lose your appetite and lose weight!

―――What!? You're telling me
my attack was deflected!?

That body... it's not just covered
in fat, is it? Underneath the
fat... it's a mass of muscle!

Just like sumo wrestlers, it’s not
just about being fat. That’s Higan
from another world for you.

Everyone, protect Strategist Higan! Don't let
them cancel Halloween! Or we won't
get our butts spanked anymore!

Oh, no! It's a real mess! Even
the participants are now siding with Higan
from the other world—it's total chaos!

This isn't looking good...! Maybe I should
radio the Netherworld Police and ask for
backup! —This is Raspberyl, requesting backup!

"It's the Netherworld Police! Stop making all
that noise right now, you jerk! What
the heck is this?! You damn octopus!!"

Don't get in the way of Strategist Fudo, you
jerk! What do you think the Netherworld Police are,
anyway?! Hey, you! You good-for-nothing piece of crap!

Raspberyl... It seems the chaos has
only gotten worse since the
Netherworld Police showed up, Plip.

I guess so... But I
can't just leave those guys
running wild like that.

If only we could stop Higan, the strategist
at the center of all this commotion.

No, I realized that just now when we exchanged blows. That strategist,
Higan—whatever his name is—is a formidable opponent. I’m not sure if we
could even win if all of us took him on together…

I have to find the real culprit behind
“The Source of the Anomaly,” and yet here
I am, stuck in a place like this…

Ugh, I've got to get out of here fast...! If
I take away all the snacks that Strategist Higan is
so obsessed with, maybe I can catch him off guard!?

T-That's way too dangerous, Plip! Just like
Higan-san in this world, he might get
angry and start rampaging without restraint!

……I’d really like to leave this
one up to Usalia’s magic, Plip!

Don't cancel Halloween!!
Protect Strategist Higan!!

(……Hehe. Everything is going according to plan.
If I can just buy a little
more time, I’ll achieve my goal……)

Whoa... I'm starting to run
a little low on sugar.

I guess I'll get some sweets
before my judgment starts to fade.
…Now, where are my snacks?
Here it is, Plip!

Oh, that's thoughtful. Well
then, I'll have some...
munch, munch. ——!?

Gwaaaaah!! I-I-it's so
spicy!! W-what is
this, aaaah!?

Strategist Higan is writhing in agony!? Usalia,
what on earth did you do?

I sprinkled a looooot
of magic powder on
Strategist Higan's treats, Plip.

Magic powder…? It sounds kind
of suspicious—is it really okay?

This magical powder, "Kill Line Reaper," is a
curry powder made with super-hot chili peppers! The
heat lingers, but it's safe and reliable!

I see. It’s working like a charm on
Higan, the strategist with a sweet tooth. He’s
working up a sweat and writhing around.

W-water…!! Someone… give
me some water…!!

chara3_name: Subordinates of the Immovable Strategist Higan
talk_text:
Water! Bring some water!
Everyone, lend a hand!
Let's save Higan-san!

Both my staff and the participants
all went off to look for
water. Now there's no one left.

You're all alone now, Strategist Higan.
Just give up and surrender!

Well, I still...
can't... just
give up...!

It's this painful and agonizing, and you're still
putting up a fight, Plip!? You shouldn't
even be able to fight properly anymore...!

Don't let your guard down, Usalia!
Even though his power has waned,
he's still the strategist Higan!

T-This burning rage…! I’m going
to settle this once and
for all…! H-Here I go…!

Oh, just as I thought... I, I just
can't... put any real strength into it...

The outcome is already decided.
Usalia, is there any way
to take away that pain?

Sure thing, Plip. If you drink this
"Carrot Lassi," it'll help take the edge
off the spiciness, Plip. Here you go.

……Gulp, gulp…… Phew! Whew……
I feel alive again!

Strategist Higan. I heard from
Adell and the others that
you're a "real bad guy."

So why did you go and do something
so selfish that caused such a commotion?

……I'm sorry for the trouble
I've caused. I've wronged you
all, so I'll explain everything.

It looks like this year's Halloween
is a big hit again!

Yeah! Looks like there was some commotion in the
square a little while ago, but the Netherworld Police
managed to keep the damage to a minimum!

Hahahaha! As long as I, the Overlord
who rules the Netherworld—this Pumpkin Prinny—am here,
you have nothing to worry about!

At this rate, we're going
to make the Shibuya Netherworld
even more exciting! Ha-ha-ha-ha!

……My reign as King of
the Dead Netherworld ends here.

Wha—an intruder!? What are the
security guards doing?! Hurry up
and catch this guy!

W-well...! It looks like everyone rushed over
to the commotion in the square,
so there's no one left here!

What?! Hey, intruder! What
on earth are
you up to?!

Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for
this opportunity for quite some time.

Now that security is down, this is
the perfect opportunity to seize the throne
of the Overlord of the Shibuya Netherworld!

The throne of the Overlord!? No way…
Do you want to kill me!?

It's not your life I
want. It's your body.

Well then... You had better
surrender your body to me!

In this Netherworld of the Dead, where I
go unnoticed except on Halloween… it’s the
perfect place to build up my strength.

Ugh...! M-my body...
won't move!

You cannot escape my power. Now,
that body of yours... you had
better surrender it to me!
I won't let that happen~♪

You're... Raspberyl XENO!? Why
are you here?!

I saw your plan coming—Fudo the
Strategist asked me to do this.

I've been looking for you for sooo long,
but you just wouldn't show your hand, you
know? So I gave you the perfect opportunity.

Fudo Gunshi-chan will cause a big commotion in the square to
distract the Netherworld Police and weaken their security, you see♪

W-What!? Did you guys
cause that commotion in
the square on purpose!?

That's right~♪ I figured that if the real
culprit were out there, they definitely wouldn't
let such a precious opportunity slip by.

See? Overlord Zenon, the Demon King♪
It's totally obvious you're trying
to imitate Rosarosa, isn't it?
……When did you realize it?

Ever since you showed up in the Netherworld—right from the start. I used
to be one of your subordinates, after all, so if I suddenly sense
you’re getting used to this place, well, you know how it is♪

It was all part of your scheme... So
I was being played like a puppet in
your hands from the very beginning... How infuriating!

But with the Netherworld Police and Immovable Strategist Higan
currently locked in battle… you’re all alone. It’ll
probably be a while before your allies arrive.

If I take care of you before then, that’ll
settle things. Go ahead and resent me all you
want—you’re all alone, with not a single ally!

―――I do have a
friend! Right here!

―――I do have a
friend! Right here!

Huh? I’ve been catching glimpses of him
here and there—isn’t that the Killer Clown?
Who on earth are you, anyway?

I'm not some murderous clown—I'm
"Lucy," one of the Netherworld
Police's top undercover agents!!
W-What the hell?!

Hahaha~♪ Who would've thought a killer
clown costume would come in handy
in a place like this~!

I'm telling you, I'm not some killer clown!
This is the costume of a sexy
villain from an American comic book movie!

She really is a villain, isn't she... Lucy really
has absolutely no sense of her role as
a member of the Netherworld Police, does she?

But since that misunderstanding kept Zenon from getting
suspicious of me, I guess it all
worked out in the end, right? ♪

Well, yeah! An undercover
pro like me will
use anything that works!

Ugh…! So… I was
actually fooled by
that ridiculous outfit…!

Looks like the operation
went well. Raspberyl XENO.

Fudo-gunshi-chan! And everyone
else came, too~♪

So this guy... was the
one behind "Halloween" all along!

I never would have guessed that Rozalin
was actually Zenon, the Overlord God from
another world… I was so surprised!

……How could I have done that? It
seems I made the wrong decision.

If I hadn't wasted time on small talk and had
just taken care of Raspberyl XENO right away, those
nuisances wouldn't have shown up in the first place...!

Disguising myself as Rozalin and sneaking into
the Halloween party went well enough,
but… I didn’t quite follow through.

I'm going to send you back to hell without
a fight, Zenon, the Overlord God of Another World!

As expected, the odds are stacked
against him when he’s up against
this many opponents. Zenon, the Overlord.

That's true. Well then, all
we have to do is
increase our numbers too! ——Haaah!

Zenon, the Overlord God from another
world, has split into two!

After all, the Overlord Zenon is
basically just a soul-like entity with
no physical form, you know~.

I can become Rozalin, and I
can even create a doppelganger.

W-Wait, does that mean if someone else takes their form
again, we won’t be able to tell them apart!?
Izuna, before that happens, we’ve got to do something—

Ah. I will definitely
defeat the Overlord Zenon.

―――Wait a minute, when did
Izuna turn into two people!?

So that clone from earlier wasn't meant to
boost their fighting power—it was just to disguise
itself as us and blend in, huh?

Ugh...! At a rate like this,
I can't tell which one
is the real Izuna-san, Plip...!

I can't very well accidentally
attack the real Izuna-san, so
what should I do……?

This is a real pain. If it had at least
been Lucy, the chronic slacker, I could’ve beaten her
up without holding back as a form of punishment…

Why is it okay for you
to hit me without hesitation!?

No, actually, this is our chance!
Everyone! Go all out and
attack the two of us!!

I... Izuna? Are
you serious?

I am the commander of the Fanged Dragon
Netherworld! I haven't trained in such a way
that I'd go down from something like this!

Besides, even if I were to
fall, I won’t hesitate to give
my life to avenge my enemies!

Heh... That's quite the resolve. No matter how much
you scheme, there are times when even the
most elaborate plans can't match a straightforward resolve.

Well then, I’ll rise to that
challenge. I’m not going to
hold back. Izuna, Overlord Zenon!

Guh...! Has the transformation worn off...! But
it's not over yet...! If I
can escape and impersonate Rozalin again—

―――That’s enough. To go so far as
to imitate my appearance and then harm
my comrades… I cannot forgive this!

Be gone! Zenon, the Overlord
God of Another World!

This Rozalin looks just
like the real thing!

I was totally surprised too—I never
would have guessed that she’d switched
places with Rosalin partway through!

……It seems Zenon, the Overlord
God of another world, has
caused trouble again. I’m sorry.

We can save the complicated stuff for later! Izuna-chan
is in serious condition, so why don't we
just take her to the hospital for now?

……I'm sorry. I wasn't in a position
to go easy on you either. You
need to get treatment right away—

No, I'm fine. For a warrior
of the Fanged Dragon Netherworld, a
wound like this is nothing.

It was my first time participating,
but… “Halloween” really is a thrilling
festival that gets the blood pumping.

It's a little different, but... as
long as Izuna had fun on
Halloween, that's all that matters, Plip.

Well, anyway, that wraps things
up—huh? I’m getting an emergency
call from the security guys.

What?! Laharl's gone on a
rampage and is wreaking havoc
all over the venue?!

I just got a report that Majorita is
handing out super-spicy candy left and right,
and the venue is in total chaos!

Let's go, Lucy! It's Halloween,
after all. We're going
to protect the peace!

What?! I even beat the Overlord
Zenon, but I haven't really
gotten to play at all!

All right... I'm starting to be
able to move again. Raspberyl! I'll
protect the peace of "Halloween" too!

Huh? You can move already? Looks like
the title of "Warrior Chief of the
Fanged Dragon Netherworld" isn't just for show.

Oh, I can't just go
to sleep. Let me help
protect this wonderful festival, too!

Alright, let's go! The
night of "Halloween" is
just getting started!

Looking at this illustration really brings
back memories of when the modified
Laharl went on a rampage...

He was really angry, wasn't he? Every
time he spotted someone in cosplay,
he'd attack them one after another.

My dad got hurt while
protecting Ao, didn't he…? I
was really worried back then.

Modified Laharl is way too dangerous! If
I hadn't found that manual, we
might have really been wiped out...

The manual said, “Pull on its antennae and it’ll
stop,” so that was a good thing, right?

Well, it all worked out in the end,
but Ao-san’s plan—pretending to be a Cat Saber
to get close—was really dangerous, wasn’t it?

If Ao gets hurt, Fuji will
be sad... so please don't
push yourself too hard, okay?

I'm sorry, Piririn. But when Dad and
everyone else are in trouble, I just
can't sit around and do nothing.

From now on, whenever I see Lahara-ha
causing trouble—Ao’s going to yank those
antennae as hard as she can!

A: That's only for Laharl when he's
been modified, you know!? You're not supposed
to do that outside of Halloween, okay!?

Damn it…! So even if I ask the Dark Assembly,
they can’t fix this right away…! Are you telling me
I have to stay like this for a while?!

You don't have to be
so reluctant... Laharl looks
really cool right now!

What are you talking about!? With
a monstrous appearance like this, there’s
absolutely nothing good about it!

He’s got nothing but great qualities! Those sinister eyes! Those
sharp claws! His physical abilities have been boosted, too! He
really gives off the vibe of the ultimate Overlord!

R-Really? …Hmph, well, for an Overlord like
me, it’s only natural that I’d look
cool no matter what form I take!

Yes! The more I look at it, the
more wonderful it is! It’s almost a shame
to put it back the way it was!

Ha~ ha ha ha ha ha ha!! Now that
you put it that way, I’m starting to
think this look isn’t so bad after all!

That's right—if that's what you want so badly, then
Flonne should just take on the same form as
me. I'll ask Jennifer to modify him for me.
Oh, that's okay.

Don't answer right away—!! Where
did all that energy from
a moment ago go—!!

Strategist Higan. I've
gathered everyone here.
What's this about?

Ah. The reason I asked you all
to gather here is none other than
this: it’s because among you here—

There's someone out there who made
me eat that super-spicy candy!!
Whaaaaaaat!?

Someone had sneaked some super-spicy candy into my
stash of sweets without me noticing. I
didn't realize it and accidentally ate one.

The crime of interrupting my happy moments is a serious
one. But if you come forward honestly… I’ll let
you off with a “11 out of 12” kill.

Isn't that thing
practically dead already!?

In that case, the culprit must be
Majorita, right? She was handing out super-spicy
candy and causing a commotion, wasn't she?

I was just handing them out myself! Why would
I go out of my way to mix them
in with the snacks other people were holding?!

If anyone's going to say that, it's you,
Usalia! I heard you made Military Strategist Higan
eat some super-spicy curry powder the other day!

I had no choice back then, Plip!
Unlike you, I wouldn't make someone eat
super-spicy food just for a laugh, Plip!

E-everyone, calm down. There were other people
at the Halloween party, too. It doesn't
necessarily mean the culprit is among us—

……No. While the incident involving the Overlord Zenon was
being resolved and I was eating some sweets, the
only people nearby were the four of you.

Even after the incident, the venue remained under tight security,
with the Netherworld Police completely blocking all entry and exit.
There is no possibility that the perpetrator was an outsider.

I see... So there is some
basis for it, after all.

Ever since that day, my throat's been sore...
I can't really eat anything sweet, and I
can only have 13 snacks a day.
That's way too much to eat!

If you don't come clean, I'll
make all of you eat some
candy laced with Kill Line Reaper.

You’d better get a good taste
of the hellish suffering I’ve endured…!

Hey! If you make me eat something like
a Kill Line Reaper, I won't be able
to use my beautiful voice for a while!

Strategist Higan... He was so
calm during Halloween, but
to go that far...

It seems she’s just like Higan-san
from this world—she goes wild when
she runs out of sweets. Plip.

……Is it taking this long? Is the culprit still
not coming forward? Well, then, I guess I’ll
just have to find out the hard way……

Ah, ah, ah, ah... I can't take it anymore... I'm gonna kill
you, okay? I'm gonna kill you, okay? I'm gonna kill you, okay?

Yikes... Looks like I've reached my limit. I'm
going to force a confession out of him.

If Military Strategist Higan really starts going wild, even
the four of us won’t get off scot-free!

That's right! I made
some donuts for Halloween!

If we let Military Strategist Higan try
some, maybe he'll calm down a little?

Way to go, Liezerota! We'll keep Strategist Higan
occupied, so while we've got him tied up,
let's grab some donuts...! Here we go!

As expected, dealing with four people
is a real pain. …I’m starting
to run out of patience, too.

He's wide open right now...!
Strategist Higan, eat this!

Whoa. I can't eat that
donut. …Not that one—the one
with the super-spicy filling.

Wha…!? How
did you…!

Heh heh… You’ve finally shown your true colors, Overlord
Zenon. …Or maybe I should call you just
a remnant of what you used to be.

Tsk… So you noticed! Well
then, I’m out of here!

No way! The Netherworld Police
have this whole area surrounded!
There's nowhere left to run!

Ugh… As expected of the Immovable Strategist Higan. I guess
I was the one who let my guard down…!

Why is the Overlord Zenon here…? Wasn’t
the real Rozalin supposed to have delivered
the final blow and then disappeared, right?

Ah. Back then, the Overlord
Zenon certainly vanished. But he’s
such a cautious guy.

I figured there was a chance he
might have left something like a backup
of himself somewhere, just in case.

So we worked with the Netherworld Police to
keep security on high alert even after
the incident—to cut off any escape routes.

So, was there some reason
why Strategist Higan mixed those
super-spicy candies into the snacks...?

I guess they planned to make me eat
something super spicy to make me go berserk,
then take advantage of the chaos to escape.

I see. So even though I’d just managed to come
back to life, you had me surrounded right there,
so there was no way for me to escape.

But even though you didn't realize who
Liezerota really was, how did you figure
out that the donut was super spicy?

You can tell right away by the smell—whether it's sweet or
spicy, for example. Plus, I knew that if I showed even
the slightest weakness, they'd make me eat something super spicy again.
